docs.title: Error Log
docs.text:
API name: Error_Log__c

Field API name Type Description Changed By Changed_By__c Lookup (User) The user whose save or job produced the change Sojourn could not record: the running user when the error was logged; for a nightly job, the admin who scheduled it. Written once by Sojourn; the Health Monitor shows it on each error.Help text: Who made the change, or which user's job was running, when Sojourn could not record it. Error Type Error_Type__c Picklist: DML, Limit, Config, BusinessHours, Unknown What kind of failure this row records, which decides how it is handled. Values: DML (an Interval write was refused), Limit (Sojourn stepped aside to keep the governor limit reserves), Config (a setup problem, such as a field or setting Sojourn cannot use), BusinessHours (business hours that could not be used, so calendar minutes were recorded), and Unknown (an unexpected error). The nightly reconcile retries New DML and Limit rows; a Health Monitor user can create the missing Interval for DML, Limit, and Unknown rows; Config and BusinessHours rows are fixed in Sojourn Settings. The Health Monitor filters by it.Help text: DML and Limit errors are retried each night. A DML, Limit, or Unknown error about one change can be recreated with Create Interval in the Health Monitor. Config and BusinessHours errors are fixed in Sojourn Settings, then marked Resolved. From Value From_Value__c Text (255) The Tracked field's value before the change that failed, as the Interval would have stored it, up to 255 characters. Blank for a record's first value, for errors not about one change, or when the value before was blank. Shown in the Health Monitor; a repair checks the change still follows the record's latest Interval.Help text: The value before the change Sojourn could not record. Message Message__c LongTextArea (32768) What went wrong, in words a screen may show; a job failure names the job and what stopped. Each nightly retry that fails adds a line (Retry 1: and the reason), and a repair that finds nothing to create adds its reason. Up to 32,768 characters, truncated beyond that. The Health Monitor shows it on each error.Help text: What went wrong and, after a retry or repair, why it was not recorded yet. Read it before choosing Create Interval, Ignore, or Resolve. Occurred At Occurred_At__c DateTime When the change happened: the time of the save, or for a Backfill, Catch up, or other job, the record's own time of the change. A repair opens the missing Interval at this moment, and the nightly retry waits until a row is at least an hour old. The Health Monitor sorts and filters errors by it.Help text: When the change Sojourn could not record happened. Create Interval starts the stay at this time. Owner Id Owner_Id__c Text (18) The 18-character Id of the record's owner (user or queue) after the failed change; for a change to the owner, the new owner. Blank on errors not about one record. A repair gives the missing Interval this owner.Help text: The user or queue that owned the record when the change happened. Parent Id Parent_Id__c Text (18) The 18-character Id of the tracked record whose change failed. Blank on errors not about one record, such as Config, BusinessHours, and job failures; those cannot be repaired or retried. The Health Monitor shows the record's name from it, and a repair or retry reads the record by it.Help text: The record whose change Sojourn could not record. Blank for setup and job errors. Parent Object Parent_Object__c Text (255) The API name of the Tracked object the failed change belongs to, for example Case. Blank on errors not about one record. The Health Monitor filters errors by it and links to the object's Sojourn Settings screen; a repair needs the object to be tracked still.Help text: The object of the record whose change failed, such as Case. Repaired Interval Repaired_Interval__c Lookup (Interval__c) The Interval created for this error, set when Create Interval in the Health Monitor or the nightly retry records the missing change and marks the error Resolved. Blank while the error is New, when it was ignored, or when it was resolved without a new Interval (the change was already recorded, or there was nothing to create).Help text: The stay Sojourn created to repair this error. Blank until a repair creates one. Retry Count Retry_Count__c Number (3, 0) How many times the nightly reconcile has retried this error and failed, a whole number from 0. Only New DML and Limit rows at least an hour old are retried, up to 200 a night, and retries stop after 3; the error then stays New for a Health Monitor user to repair, ignore, or resolve. Each failed retry adds its reason to Message.Help text: Failed nightly retries so far. After 3, Sojourn stops retrying and the error waits in the Health Monitor. Source Source__c Picklist: Trigger, Flow, Backfill-History, Backfill-Seed, Manual-Repair, Reconcile, Catch-Up, Omni-Channel Which capture path hit the error. Values: Trigger or Flow (live capture), Backfill-History or Backfill-Seed (Backfill), Catch-Up, Reconcile, Manual-Repair (a repair from the Health Monitor), or Omni-Channel. Blank on Config, BusinessHours, and job errors not raised by a capture path.Help text: Where the failed change came from, for example Trigger, Flow, or Backfill-History. Stack Stack__c LongTextArea (32768) The Apex stack trace of the exception behind the error, and for a job failure the platform's own message, up to 32,768 characters. Blank when no exception caused it. Only the Sojourn Admin permission set reads it, on the Health Monitor, the record page, and in reports; Sojourn Health Monitor has no access to it. Kept for support.Help text: Technical detail for support. Only Sojourn admins can read it. Status Status__c Picklist: New, Resolved, Ignored Where the error stands. Values: New (the default: waiting for a retry or a decision), Resolved (the missing Interval was created, the change was already recorded, or someone marked it fixed), and Ignored (someone chose to leave it). Only New rows are retried or repaired; Resolved and Ignored rows are kept for audit. The Health Monitor filters by it and its Ignore and Resolve actions set it.Help text: New errors wait for a nightly retry or your decision. Set Ignored to leave one, or Resolved once it is fixed; both are kept for audit. To Value Id To_Value_Id__c Text (18) For a change to an owner or lookup field, the 18-character Id behind the new value: the user, queue, or related record. Blank for other field types. A repair needs it to recreate the change and to tell whether the record's latest Interval already holds the value.Help text: For an owner or lookup change, the Id of the new user, queue, or record. Blank otherwise. To Value To_Value__c Text (255) The Tracked field's value after the change that failed, as the Interval would have stored it (a picklist's API value, the text, or an owner's or lookup's display name), up to 255 characters. A repair opens the missing Interval in this value.Help text: The value after the change Sojourn could not record. Tracked Field Tracked_Field__c Text (255) The API name of the Tracked field whose change failed, for example Status or OwnerId. Blank on errors not about one change. A repair needs the field to be tracked still on the object.Help text: The field whose change Sojourn could not record, such as Status.

docs.title: Goal
docs.text:
API name: Goal__c

Field API name Type Description Active Is_Active__c Checkbox Whether this Goal is applied to new Intervals. A checkbox, on by default. Only active Goals are loaded with the configuration, so an inactive Goal is not stamped on Intervals that open afterwards and no longer counts for Live values. Intervals already stamped keep their Goal Minutes and Warn Minutes, so their Breach and warning flags still follow the old target. Set on the Goals screen of Sojourn Settings, or by a settings file import.Help text: Inactive Goals are kept for history but not applied to new stays. Stays that already have the Goal keep it. Split Value Split_Value__c Text (255) The value of the Tracked field's Goal Split Field that this Goal is for, for example High when the split field is Priority. Blank, the default, means any value of the split field: the fallback when no Goal names the record's split value. Goals stay unique on Tracked field, value, and split value. For a checkbox split field the value is true or false. Read when an Interval opens, where the most specific Goal wins: the value with this split value first, then the value with any split value, then Any value with this split value, then Any value with any split value. A Goal with a split value takes the Warn At Percent of its value's Goal with a blank split value when that Goal exists. Applies only while the Tracked field names a Goal Split Field. Set on the Goals screen of Sojourn Settings.Help text: The split field value this Goal applies to, such as High. Leave blank for any value; a Goal for the record's own split value is chosen first. Target Business Minutes Target_Business_Minutes__c Number (16, 2) How many business minutes an Interval in this Goal's value may last before it is a Breach. Required; a number of minutes with two decimal places, 0 or more. Copied onto each matching Interval as Goal Minutes when the Interval opens, so changing it applies only to Intervals that open afterwards. Live values flags an open Interval as breached once its business minutes pass it, and the close flags one that ran past it. Set on the Goals screen of Sojourn Settings, where a blank target means no Goal, or by a settings file import.Help text: A stay in this value should end within this many business minutes; past it, the stay is a Breach. Changing it applies to stays that begin afterwards. Tracked Field Tracked_Field__c Lookup (Tracked_Field__c) The Tracked field whose values this Goal measures, for example Priority. Blank: the Goal applies to the Tracked object's status field. Read when each Interval opens to find its Goal: the Goal applies only to Intervals of this field. Owner fields take no Goals. Deleting the Tracked field clears this lookup, which moves the Goal to the status field. Set on the Goals screen of Sojourn Settings, or by a settings file import, which names the field.Help text: The Tracked field this Goal applies to, for example Status. Leave blank for the object's status field. Tracked Object Tracked_Object__c Master-detail (Tracked_Object__c) The Tracked object this Goal belongs to, as the master record: deleting the Tracked object deletes its Goals. Required. Its active Goals load with its configuration, and its business hours decide how business minutes are counted against the target. Set on the Goals screen of Sojourn Settings, or by a settings file import.Help text: The Tracked object this Goal applies to. Set by Sojourn Settings. Value Value__c Text (255) The field value the Goal applies to, as Sojourn records it in an Interval's To Value (the API value of a picklist), for example Working; or an asterisk () for any value. Required. When an Interval opens, a Goal for its exact value wins over a * Goal of the same field. Matched without regard to case. Set on the Goals screen of Sojourn Settings, which shows * as Any value, or by a settings file import.Help text:* The status or stage value, for example Working, or * for any value. A Goal for the exact value wins over a * Goal. Warn At Percent Warn_At_Percent__c Number (3, 0) The share of the target, in percent, at which Sojourn flags an Interval as a warning before it breaches. A whole number from 1 to 100, enforced by a validation rule; blank: no warning. Copied onto each matching Interval as Warn Minutes when the Interval opens (the target times this percent); Live values and the close set Interval Warning and Warned At when its business minutes reach them. A breached Interval is always a warning too. Set on the Goals screen of Sojourn Settings, or by a settings file import.Help text: Flag a stay as a warning when its business minutes reach this percentage of the target, 1 to 100. Leave blank for no warning.

docs.title: Interval Archive
docs.text:
API name: Interval_Archive__b

Field API name Type Description Breach Flag Breach_Flag__c Number (1, 0) Archived copy of the Interval's Is Breached: 1 when its business minutes passed its Goal's target, else 0 (also 0 when no Goal applied). Big objects have no checkbox type, so a number stands in. Written once by a purge run with Archive Enabled on, from the Interval it deletes; archive rows are never changed. Not in the index, so an archive query cannot filter on it.Help text: 1 when this archived stay went past its Goal's target, 0 when it did not. Business Minutes Business_Minutes__c Number (16, 2) Archived copy of the Interval's Business Minutes: the time from Entered At to Exited At that fell inside its Business hours, in minutes. Written once by a purge run with Archive Enabled on, from the Interval it deletes; archive rows are never changed. The record page timeline shows it for archived stays.Help text: How long this archived stay lasted inside Business hours, in minutes. Calendar Minutes Calendar_Minutes__c Number (16, 2) Archived copy of the Interval's Calendar Minutes: the elapsed clock time from Entered At to Exited At, in minutes, nights and weekends included. Written once by a purge run with Archive Enabled on, from the Interval it deletes; archive rows are never changed. The record page timeline shows it for archived stays.Help text: How long this archived stay lasted in elapsed time, in minutes. Entered At Entered_At__c DateTime Archived copy of the Interval's Entered At: when the record took this value. The third field of the archive's index, newest first, after Parent Id and Tracked Field, so a read for one record and field returns its newest stays first. Written once by a purge run with Archive Enabled on, from the Interval it deletes; archive rows are never changed. The record page timeline places archived stays by it.Help text: When this archived stay began. The timeline places archived stays by it. Exited At Exited_At__c DateTime Archived copy of the Interval's Exited At: when the record left this value. Never blank, since a purge removes only closed Intervals. Written once by a purge run with Archive Enabled on, from the Interval it deletes; archive rows are never changed. The record page timeline reads it.Help text: When this archived stay ended. Only closed stays are archived, so it is always set. From Value From_Value__c Text (255) Archived copy of the Interval's From Value: the Tracked field's value just before this stay began, as the Interval stored it. Blank for the first stay of a record's field or when the value before was blank. Written once by a purge run with Archive Enabled on, from the Interval it deletes; archive rows are never changed. The timeline does not read it; it is kept for audits.Help text: The value the record held just before this archived stay. Goal Minutes Goal_Minutes__c Number (16, 2) Archived copy of the Interval's Goal Minutes: the target, in business minutes, of the Goal that applied when the stay began. Blank when no Goal applied. Breach Flag records whether Business Minutes passed it. Written once by a purge run with Archive Enabled on, from the Interval it deletes; archive rows are never changed.Help text: The Goal's target for this archived stay, in business minutes. Blank when no Goal applied. Original Interval Name Original_Interval_Name__c Text (30) The Interval's auto-number Name before the purge deleted it, in the form INT-000001234, up to 30 characters, so an archived row can be matched to the purge run's CSV files and to reports run while the Interval existed. Written once by a purge run with Archive Enabled on, from the Interval it deletes; archive rows are never changed. The record page timeline uses it to tell archived stays apart and to drop an archived row whose Interval still exists after a failed purge chunk.Help text: The Interval's number before it was archived, for example INT-000001234. Use it to find the stay in the purge run's CSV files. Owner Id Owner_Id__c Text (18) Archived copy of the Interval's Owner Id: the 18-character Id of the user or queue that owned the record during this stay, whatever field is tracked. Written once by a purge run with Archive Enabled on, from the Interval it deletes; archive rows are never changed.Help text: The Id of the user or queue that owned the record during this archived stay. Owner Name Owner_Name__c Text (255) Archived copy of the Interval's Owner Name: the display name of the user or queue that owned the record during this stay, as it was when the stay was recorded. Written once by a purge run with Archive Enabled on, from the Interval it deletes; archive rows are never changed. The record page timeline shows it on archived owner stays.Help text: The name of the user or queue that owned the record during this archived stay. Owner Type Owner_Type__c Text (10) Archived copy of the Interval's Owner Type: User or Queue, as text up to 10 characters, since big objects have no picklist type. Written once by a purge run with Archive Enabled on, from the Interval it deletes; archive rows are never changed. The record page timeline reads it.Help text: User or Queue: who owned the record during this archived stay. Parent Id Parent_Id__c Text (18) Archived copy of the Interval's Parent Id: the 18-character Id of the tracked record. The first field of the archive's index, so every archive read names one record. Written once by a purge run with Archive Enabled on, from the Interval it deletes; archive rows are never changed. The record page timeline reads a record's archived stays by it.Help text: The Id of the record this archived stay belongs to. Parent Name Parent_Name__c Text (255) Archived copy of the Interval's Parent Name: the record's name or number, such as a Case Number, as it was when the stay was recorded, up to 255 characters. Written once by a purge run with Archive Enabled on, from the Interval it deletes; archive rows are never changed.Help text: The record's name or number when this stay was recorded, for example a Case Number. Parent Object Parent_Object__c Text (255) Archived copy of the Interval's Parent Object: the full API name of the Tracked object, for example Case or Work_Order__c. Stored but not in the index, so an archive query cannot filter on it. Written once by a purge run with Archive Enabled on, from the Interval it deletes; archive rows are never changed.Help text: The object this archived stay belongs to, such as Case. Record Closed Flag Record_Closed_Flag__c Number (1, 0) Archived copy of the Interval's Record Closed: 1 when the stay was time spent while its record was closed, else 0. Big objects have no checkbox type, so a number stands in. Kept so the archive holds every part of the summary key the Interval was counted under. Written once by a purge run with Archive Enabled on, from the Interval it deletes; archive rows are never changed. Not in the index.Help text: 1 when the record was already closed during this archived stay, else 0. Sequence Sequence__c Number (9, 0) Archived copy of the Interval's Sequence: its place in the chain of stays for one record and field, 1 for the first and counting up; 0 when the Interval had none, since an index field cannot be blank. The fourth field of the archive's index, so two stays entered in the same second stay distinct. Written once by a purge run with Archive Enabled on, from the Interval it deletes; archive rows are never changed.Help text: The order of this archived stay among the record's stays in the same field. Source Source__c Text (40) Archived copy of the Interval's Source, as text up to 40 characters: how the stay was recorded. Values: Trigger or Flow (live capture), Backfill-History or Backfill-Seed (Backfill), Catch-Up, Reconcile, Manual-Repair (created from the Error Log), or Omni-Channel. Written once by a purge run with Archive Enabled on, from the Interval it deletes; archive rows are never changed.Help text: How this archived stay was recorded, for example Trigger, Flow, or Backfill-History. To Value Id To_Value_Id__c Text (18) Archived copy of the Interval's To Value Id: the 18-character Id behind the value of an owner or lookup field, such as the user or queue Id. Blank for picklist, text, and other fields. Written once by a purge run with Archive Enabled on, from the Interval it deletes; archive rows are never changed.Help text: For an owner or lookup field, the Id of the user, queue, or record this stay was in. Blank otherwise. To Value Label To_Value_Label__c Text (255) Archived copy of the Interval's To Value Label: a picklist value's label as it was when the stay was recorded; blank for other field types. Written once by a purge run with Archive Enabled on, from the Interval it deletes; archive rows are never changed. The record page timeline shows it in place of the API value when set.Help text: The picklist label of the value this archived stay was in, as it read then. To Value To_Value__c Text (255) Archived copy of the Interval's To Value: the value the record held during this stay, as the Interval stored it (a picklist's API value, the text, or an owner's or lookup's display name). Blank when the value was blank. Written once by a purge run with Archive Enabled on, from the Interval it deletes; archive rows are never changed. The record page timeline shows it.Help text: The value the record held during this archived stay. Tracked Field Tracked_Field__c Text (60) Archived copy of the Interval's Tracked Field: the API name of the field in full, up to 60 characters, which fits any namespaced field name. The second field of the archive's index, after Parent Id. Written once by a purge run with Archive Enabled on, from the Interval it deletes; archive rows are never changed. The record page timeline reads one field's archived stays by it.Help text: The field this archived stay measures, such as Status or OwnerId. Value Group Value_Group__c Text (255) Archived copy of the Interval's Value Group: the named group its value belonged to, such as Backlog. Blank when the field had no value groups. Kept so the archive holds every part of the summary key the Interval was counted under. Written once by a purge run with Archive Enabled on, from the Interval it deletes; archive rows are never changed. Not in the index.Help text: The named group of values this archived stay counted toward. Blank when the field had no value groups. Warn Minutes Warn_Minutes__c Number (16, 2) Archived copy of the Interval's Warn Minutes: the business minutes at which the stay became a warning, its Goal's Warn At Percent of the target, copied when the stay began. Blank when its Goal set no warn percent or no Goal applied. Written once by a purge run with Archive Enabled on, from the Interval it deletes; archive rows are never changed.Help text: Business minutes at which this archived stay would become a warning. Blank when its Goal had no warning. Warned At Warned_At__c DateTime Archived copy of the Interval's Warned At: when its business minutes reached its Warn Minutes, counted in its Business hours. Blank when it never became a warning. Written once by a purge run with Archive Enabled on, from the Interval it deletes; archive rows are never changed.Help text: When this archived stay became a warning. Blank when it never did. Warning Flag Warning_Flag__c Number (1, 0) Archived copy of the Interval's Is Warning: 1 when its business minutes reached its Warn Minutes, else 0. Big objects have no checkbox type, so a number stands in. Written once by a purge run with Archive Enabled on, from the Interval it deletes; archive rows are never changed. Not in the index.Help text: 1 when this archived stay reached its Goal's warn percent, 0 when it did not.

docs.title: Interval Summary
docs.text:
API name: Interval_Summary__c

Field API name Type Description All Owners All_Owners__c Checkbox Checked on an all-owners row: the same period, Tracked object, Tracked field, value, value group, and Record Closed as the per-owner rows, with every owner's Intervals added together. Its key's owner part is an asterisk (), and Owner Id, Owner Name, Owner Type, and Owner User are blank. Unchecked (the default) on a per-owner row. The nightly Summaries job adds each closed Interval to its owner's rows and to the all-owners rows, so every Interval is counted twice. Sojourn Dashboards read the all-owners rows for org-wide charts and the per-owner rows for owner charts; the packaged summary reports keep All Owners false.Help text:* Checked when this row adds up every owner together. Each stay is counted in its owner's row and again in an all-owners row, so filter any report you build on All Owners, or its totals double. Avg Business Minutes Avg_Business_Minutes__c Number (16, 2) The average business minutes of the Intervals this row counts: Sum Business Minutes divided by Interval Count, to two decimal places. Business minutes count only time inside each Interval's Business hours. Recalculated by the nightly Summaries job each time it adds Intervals to the row; blank while no counted Interval has business minutes.Help text: Average time per stay in this row, inside Business hours. To average across several rows, divide the summed Sum Business Minutes by the summed Interval Count instead of averaging this column. Avg Calendar Minutes Avg_Calendar_Minutes__c Number (16, 2) The average calendar minutes of the Intervals this row counts: Sum Calendar Minutes divided by Interval Count, to two decimal places. Calendar minutes are the elapsed clock time from Entered At to Exited At, nights and weekends included. Recalculated by the nightly Summaries job each time it adds Intervals to the row; blank while no counted Interval has calendar minutes.Help text: Average elapsed time per stay in this row, nights and weekends included. To average across several rows, divide the summed Sum Calendar Minutes by the summed Interval Count. Breach Count Breach_Count__c Number (9, 0) How many of the Intervals this row counts were breached: their business minutes passed their Goal's target (the Interval's Is Breached). A whole number, 0 when none breached. Added to by the nightly Summaries job. Sojourn Dashboards add it up for breach charts, and take it from Goal Count for Goal met: the share of the Intervals with a Goal that stayed within it.Help text: Stays in this row that went past their Goal's target. Divide by Interval Count for the breach rate. Goal Count Goal_Count__c Number (18, 0) How many of the closed Intervals this row counts had a Goal: a Goal target (Goal Minutes) stamped when the stay started. A whole number, 0 when none of them had one. A row first built before this field existed holds it blank, and keeps it blank when a late Interval adds to it, until Rebuild summaries counts its months again. Added to by the nightly Summaries job and set again by Rebuild summaries, beside Interval Count. Breach Count over Goal Count is the share of stays with a Goal that went past it, so a value with no Goal is left out rather than counted as met. Sojourn Dashboards' Goal met is the summed Goal Count less the summed Breach Count, over the summed Goal Count, so a value with no Goal shows a dash rather than 100 percent; while any row a chart adds up holds it blank, Goal met shows a dash there until Rebuild summaries counts the row again. Also read by reports on the Sojourn Interval Summaries report type.Help text: Stays in this row that had a Goal when they started. Set by Sojourn. Compare Breach Count with this, not with Interval Count, to leave out values that have no Goal. Granularity Granularity__c Picklist: Day, Month The length of the period this row covers: Day or Month. The nightly Summaries job adds each closed Interval to one Day row, for the day it ended in the org's time zone, and to one Month row for that month, so Day and Month rows count the same Intervals and are never added together. Day rows older than Summary Rollup Days (blank means 400) are deleted only at the end of a complete purge run; purge never deletes Month rows. Sojourn Dashboards and the summary reports filter on one granularity.Help text: Day rows count one day; Month rows count a whole month. The same stays are in both, so filter a report to one granularity. Old Day rows are removed only by a purge run; Month rows are kept. Interval Count Interval_Count__c Number (9, 0) How many closed Intervals this row counts, a whole number. The nightly Summaries job adds 1 for each closed Interval not yet summarised (an Interval is summarised once, which sets its Summarised At); Rebuild summaries deletes the rows of the chosen months and counts their Intervals again. Sojourn Dashboards and the summary reports add it up for counts and divide summed minutes by it for averages.Help text: Number of stays this row counts. Add it up across rows for totals, and divide summed minutes by it for averages. Max Business Minutes Max_Business_Minutes__c Number (16, 2) The longest single Interval this row counts, in business minutes (time inside its Business hours). Kept by the nightly Summaries job as it adds Intervals to the row; blank while no counted Interval has business minutes.Help text: The longest stay in this row, inside Business hours. Compare it with the average to spot the outliers behind it. Max Calendar Minutes Max_Calendar_Minutes__c Number (16, 2) The longest single Interval this row counts, in calendar minutes (elapsed clock time, nights and weekends included). Kept by the nightly Summaries job as it adds Intervals to the row; blank while no counted Interval has calendar minutes.Help text: The longest stay in this row in elapsed time. Compare it with the average to spot the outliers behind it. Min Business Minutes Min_Business_Minutes__c Number (16, 2) The shortest single Interval this row counts, in business minutes (time inside its Business hours); 0 when a stay fell wholly outside its hours. Kept by the nightly Summaries job as it adds Intervals to the row; blank while no counted Interval has business minutes.Help text: The shortest stay in this row, inside Business hours. A 0 means a stay began and ended outside Business hours. Min Calendar Minutes Min_Calendar_Minutes__c Number (16, 2) The shortest single Interval this row counts, in calendar minutes (elapsed clock time). Kept by the nightly Summaries job as it adds Intervals to the row; blank while no counted Interval has calendar minutes.Help text: The shortest stay in this row in elapsed time, nights and weekends included. Owner Id Owner_Id__c Text (18) The 18-character Id of the user or queue that owned the records during the Intervals this row counts, copied from each Interval's Owner Id; part of the row's key, so each owner has rows of their own. Blank on an all-owners row. Written by the nightly Summaries job. Sojourn Dashboards group and filter owner charts by it.Help text: The user or queue that owned the records during these stays. Blank when All Owners is checked. Owner Name Owner_Name__c Text (255) The display name of the user or queue in Owner Id, copied from the first Interval that created the row; a later rename does not change rows already written. Blank on an all-owners row. Written by the nightly Summaries job; owner charts in Sojourn Dashboards and the Owner Leaderboard report show it.Help text: Name of the user or queue these stays belonged to, as it was when the row was first built. Blank when All Owners is checked. Owner Type Owner_Type__c Picklist: User, Queue Whether the owner in Owner Id is a user or a queue. Allowed values: User, Queue. Copied from the counted Intervals by the nightly Summaries job; blank on an all-owners row. The Owner Leaderboard report keeps User rows only.Help text: User or Queue. Filter to User to rank people; Queue rows show time records waited in a queue. Owner User Owner_User__c Lookup (User) The owner as a lookup to User, set only when Owner Id is a user; blank for a queue owner and on an all-owners row. Lets a report on Interval Summaries reach the user's role, manager, and other user fields. Written by the nightly Summaries job.Help text: The owning user as a lookup, so a report can group by role or manager. Blank for queues and on all-owners rows. Parent Object Parent_Object__c Text (255) The API name of the Tracked object whose Intervals this row counts, for example Case or Work_Order__c; part of the row's key. Copied from the counted Intervals by the nightly Summaries job. Sojourn Dashboards and the summary reports filter on it to keep one object's rows.Help text: The object these stays belong to, such as Case. Filter on it so a report shows one object. Period Start Period_Start__c Date The first day of the period this row covers: for a Day row, the day the counted Intervals ended; for a Month row, the first day of that month. Days follow the org's time zone. Part of the row's key. Sojourn Dashboards filter on it for their date range, Rebuild summaries replaces the rows of whole months by it, and a purge deletes old Day rows by it.Help text: The day, or the first day of the month, these stays ended in. Use it as the date in trend reports and date filters. Record Closed Record_Closed__c Checkbox Checked when the Intervals this row counts were time spent while their record was closed (each Interval's Record Closed, set by the object's Closed when rule), so closed time is kept in rows of its own; part of the row's key. Unchecked by default. Sojourn Dashboards and the Average Hours per Status by Week report leave these rows out.Help text: Checked when this row counts time spent while the record was already closed. Filter it out to see working time only. Record Count Record_Count__c Number (9, 0) How many distinct tracked records the counted Intervals belong to, counting each record once per row in each Summaries run. A record whose Intervals reach the same row in two runs, such as on two nights of one month, is counted again, so the figure can be above the true distinct count, most often on Month rows. Rebuild summaries counts each record once per row. Written by the nightly Summaries job.Help text: Records behind the stays in this row. A record added on two different nights counts twice, so read it as approximate on Month rows. Record Type Record_Type__c Text (255) Reserved for the record type of the counted records, as one of the ten parts of the row's key. Always blank today: no Sojourn setting splits summaries by record type yet. Because the key already holds the part, a later split needs only Rebuild summaries, not new rows.Help text: Blank today: Sojourn does not split summaries by record type yet. Snapshot 1 Snapshot_1__c Text (255) Reserved for the first Snapshot field's value of the counted Intervals, as one of the ten parts of the row's key. Always blank today: no Sojourn setting splits summaries by a Snapshot field yet. Because the key already holds the part, a later split needs only Rebuild summaries, not new rows.Help text: Blank today: Sojourn does not split summaries by a Snapshot field yet. Sum Business Minutes Sum_Business_Minutes__c Number (16, 2) The total business minutes of the Intervals this row counts: the time inside each Interval's Business hours, added up. Blank until an Interval with business minutes is added. Added to by the nightly Summaries job. Sojourn Dashboards and the summary reports, such as Average Hours per Status by Week, add it across rows and divide by Interval Count for averages.Help text: Total time inside Business hours across this row's stays. Add it across rows and divide by Interval Count for a true average. Sum Calendar Minutes Sum_Calendar_Minutes__c Number (16, 2) The total calendar minutes of the Intervals this row counts: the elapsed clock time from each Interval's Entered At to its Exited At, nights and weekends included, added up. Blank until an Interval with calendar minutes is added. Added to by the nightly Summaries job; Sojourn Dashboards add it across rows.Help text: Total elapsed time across this row's stays, nights and weekends included. Divide by Interval Count for the average. To Value To_Value__c Text (255) The value of the Tracked field the counted Intervals held, as each Interval stores it: a picklist's API value, the text of a text field, or the display name for an owner or lookup field. Part of the row's key; blank when the Intervals held a blank value. Copied by the nightly Summaries job. Reports and Sojourn Dashboards group by it for time per status, stage, or owner.Help text: The status, stage, owner, or other value these stays were in. Group by it to see time per value. Tracked Field Tracked_Field__c Text (255) The API name of the Tracked field whose Intervals this row counts, for example Status or OwnerId; part of the row's key. Copied from the counted Intervals by the nightly Summaries job. Each Tracked field has rows of its own, so Sojourn Dashboards and the packaged summary reports always filter on it before grouping by To Value.Help text: The field these stays measure, such as Status or OwnerId. Filter on one field first, then group by To Value. Unique Code Unique_Code__c Text (255) The row's key, set by the Summaries job so each combination has exactly one row: the 64-character lowercase hex SHA-256 of ten parts joined by pipes, each written as its length, a colon, and its text (a blank part is 0:). The parts are Granularity, Period Start (yyyy-MM-dd), Parent Object, Tracked Field, To Value, Owner Id (an asterisk on an all-owners row), Value Group, Record Type, Snapshot 1, and Record Closed (closed, or blank). Each run reads the stored rows by this code and adds to them.Help text: Set by the Summaries job to keep one row per period, object, field, value, owner, and the other key parts. Do not edit it: the next run would start a second row for the same combination. Value Group Value_Group__c Text (255) The value group of the counted Intervals, copied from each Interval's Value Group: a named set of the Tracked field's values, such as Backlog for New and Reopened. Part of the row's key. Blank when the Intervals carry no value group, as every Interval does until value groups are set up for its field. Sojourn Dashboards can group a chart by it.Help text: The named group of values these stays count toward. Blank when the field has no value groups. Warning Count Warning_Count__c Number (9, 0) How many of the Intervals this row counts were warnings (the Interval's Is Warning): their business minutes reached their warn minutes, the Goal's Warn At Percent of its target. A breached Interval is also a warning when its Goal has a Warn At Percent. A whole number, 0 when none. Added to by the nightly Summaries job.Help text: Stays in this row that reached their Goal's Warn at percent. A Breach also counts here when its Goal sets a warn percent.

docs.title: Interval
docs.text:
API name: Interval__c

Field API name Type Description Breached At Breached_At__c DateTime When this Interval passed its Goal: Entered At plus Goal Minutes, counted in the Interval's business hours, so it is the moment the goal ran out, not the moment Sojourn noticed. Set together with Breached, by a Live values run on an open Interval or by the close on a closed one, and kept once set. Blank while the Interval is within its goal, or when it has no Goal. Reports read it to show when stays broke their goal.Help text: The moment this stay went past its goal, worked out from when the stay began and the goal's business minutes. Sojourn sets it; blank while the stay is within its goal. Business Days (8 h) Business_Days__c Formula (Number) Business Minutes divided by 480: days of eight business hours, whatever the business hours behind the Interval. A formula to two decimals; 0 while the Interval is open, since Business Minutes is set at the close. For other day lengths, divide Business Minutes in a report formula.Help text: Business minutes as days of eight hours. If your business day is longer or shorter, use Business Minutes instead. Business Hours Display Business_Hours_Display__c Formula (Text) Business Minutes as text in hours and minutes, for example 34h 15m: a formula of the whole hours and the minutes left over (part minutes show as decimals, such as 34h 15.5m). Blank while the Interval is open, since Business Minutes is set at the close. For reading on a record page or in a report; text cannot be summed, so total Business Minutes instead.Help text: How long this stay lasted in business hours, written as hours and minutes, for example 34h 15m. Blank while the stay is open. Business Hours Id Business_Hours_Id__c Text (18) The 18-character Id of the Business hours record this Interval's business minutes were counted in. Sojourn takes the first that applies: the Tracked field's business hours, the business hours on the record (the Tracked object's Business Hours Source Field), the queue that owned the record (Queue Business Hours), the Tracked object's business hours, the Sojourn default, then the org default. Set at the close and refreshed by each Live values run while the Interval is open; blank on an open Interval that Live values has not reached. Kept so the minutes can be checked or worked out again; the timeline and Sojourn Dashboards read it to name the hours.Help text: The business hours this stay was measured in. Sojourn picks them from the Tracked field, the record, its queue, the Tracked object, or the default, in that order. Business Minutes To Date Business_Minutes_To_Date__c Number (16, 2) Business minutes this Interval has lasted so far, in its business hours, to two decimals. On an open Interval each Live values run writes it, when the Live values job covers the object (Live values on, or Goals to flag) and the Interval began inside the Live values window; otherwise it stays blank or keeps its last value. At the close it is set equal to Business Minutes. Reports of open stays, such as Longest Open Intervals, sort on it.Help text: Business minutes so far for an open stay, refreshed each time the Live values job runs; the same as Business Minutes once the stay closes. Blank or out of date when the Live values job does not cover the object. Business Minutes Business_Minutes__c Number (16, 2) Minutes between Entered At and Exited At that fall inside the Interval's business hours (Business Hours Id), to two decimals. Set when the Interval closes; blank while it is open. When those business hours cannot be used (deleted or inactive), calendar minutes are recorded instead. Breach, the Case figures, Interval Summaries, and reports all count this value.Help text: How long this stay lasted inside business hours. Sojourn sets it when the stay closes; blank while open. Use it for totals and averages. Calendar Days Calendar_Days__c Formula (Number) Calendar Minutes divided by 1,440: the stay's time on the clock as 24-hour days, nights and weekends included. A formula to two decimals; 0 while the Interval is open, since Calendar Minutes is set at the close.Help text: How long this stay lasted on the clock, in 24-hour days. 0 while the stay is open. Calendar Minutes To Date Calendar_Minutes_To_Date__c Formula (Number) Calendar minutes so far: on an open Interval, the minutes from Entered At to now, worked out each time the field is read; on a closed one, Calendar Minutes. A formula to two decimals, so it is always current and needs no job. Reports of open stays read it for their age on the clock.Help text: How long this stay has lasted on the clock: up to now while it is open, the final minutes once it closes. Calendar Minutes Calendar_Minutes__c Number (16, 2) Minutes on the clock between Entered At and Exited At, nights and weekends included, to two decimals. Set when the Interval closes; blank while it is open. Calendar Days and Elapsed Calendar Hours are formulas on it, and Interval Summaries count it beside Business Minutes.Help text: How long this stay lasted on the clock. Sojourn sets it when the stay closes; blank while open. Case Origin Case_Origin__c Text (255) The Case's Origin (its API value, as text) copied when the Interval opened, so time can be reported by channel as it was then. Filled only on Intervals of Cases; a later edit to the Case does not change it. Blank when the Case had no Origin.Help text: The Case's origin when this stay began, for example Email or Phone. Group a report by it to compare time by channel. Case Priority Case_Priority__c Text (255) The Case's Priority (its API value, as text) copied when the Interval opened, so time can be reported by priority as it was then. Filled only on Intervals of Cases; a later edit to the Case does not change it. Blank when the Case had no Priority.Help text: The Case's priority when this stay began, for example High. Group a report by it to compare time by priority. Case Type Case_Type__c Text (255) The Case's Type (its API value, as text) copied when the Interval opened, so time can be reported by case type as it was then. Filled only on Intervals of Cases; a later edit to the Case does not change it. Blank when the Case had no Type.Help text: The Case's type when this stay began. Group a report by it to compare time by case type. Case Case__c Lookup (Case) Lookup to the Case when the Tracked object is Case, filled from Parent Id when the Interval is written, so the Cases with Intervals report type and the Intervals related list on the Case work. Blank for other objects, or when the Tracked object's Lookup Field Override names another lookup to Case. Cleared if the Case is deleted; Parent Id keeps the Id.Help text: The Case this stay belongs to. Sojourn fills it on Case Intervals; it drives the Intervals related list on the Case and the Cases with Intervals reports. Changed By Changed_By__c Lookup (User) Who made the change that started this Interval. For an Interval a job wrote (Reconcile, Catch up, backfill, or a repair), the user who ran or scheduled that job, not the person who changed the record; Source tells which.Help text: The user whose save started this Interval. When Source is Reconcile, Catch-Up, Backfill, or Manual-Repair, it is the user who ran or scheduled that job. Closed at Deletion Closed_At_Deletion__c Checkbox Checked by the nightly Reconcile on an Interval it closed because its record was deleted. When the record comes back from the Recycle Bin, only these Intervals open again and the check is cleared; an Interval that ended before the deletion stays ended. Unchecked on every other Interval. The Summaries job leaves a checked Interval out until the Recycle Bin's 15 days have passed, so a restored record's stay is counted once, at its real close.Help text: Checked when this Interval was ended only because its record was deleted. If the record is restored from the Recycle Bin, this Interval opens again. Elapsed Business Hours Elapsed_Business_Hours__c Formula (Number) Time the Interval took in business hours: Business Minutes divided by 60, a formula to two decimals; 0 while the Interval is open. A duration, not the Business hours schedule; Business Hours Id names the schedule used.Help text: Elapsed time in this value, counted in business hours, as hours with two decimals. Elapsed Calendar Hours Elapsed_Calendar_Hours__c Formula (Number) Time the Interval took on the clock: Calendar Minutes divided by 60, nights and weekends included, a formula to two decimals; 0 while the Interval is open.Help text: Elapsed time in this value on the clock, as hours with two decimals. Entered At Entered_At__c DateTime When the record took this value and the Interval began. For a live save it is the time of the save, or the record's created time for a new record's first Intervals; a job sets it to when the change happened, from field history (Backfill-History), the record's last change (Backfill-Seed, Reconcile, Catch-Up), or the logged change (Manual-Repair, Omni-Channel). Never blank. Every minute count and the Breach and warning times are counted from it.Help text: When the record entered this value. Every minute count of the stay starts here. Exited At Exited_At__c DateTime When the record left this value and the Interval closed: the time of the change that opened the next Interval, the close of the record for an owner stay that ends there, or the deletion time when Reconcile closes it for a deleted record. Never before Entered At. Blank while the Interval is open; Open is a formula on it, and the minutes are set at the same moment.Help text: When the stay ended. Blank while the record is still in this value. From Value From_Value__c Text (255) The value the record held before this Interval, in the same form as To Value (the API value for a picklist, the display name for an owner or lookup), up to 255 characters. Blank on a record's first Interval for the field, or when the field was blank before. Reports read it to count moves from one value to the next.Help text: The value the record had before this stay began. Blank on the first stay of a record. Goal Minutes Goal_Minutes__c Number (16, 2) The Goal's Target Business Minutes, copied when the Interval opened from the active Goal that matched its value (a Goal for this exact value wins over one for any value, ). Blank when no Goal matched. Breach is judged against this copy, so a later change to the Goal, or turning it off, leaves this Interval's target as it was. The timeline and Sojourn Dashboards show it as the goal.Help text:* The business minutes this stay was allowed before it counts as a Breach, copied from its Goal when the stay began. Goal Goal__c Lookup (Goal__c) Lookup to the active Goal that matched this Interval when it opened: a Goal for this Tracked field (or, when the Goal names no field, for the Tracked object's status field) and this value, or one for any value (). Blank when none matched. Goal Minutes and Warn Minutes copy its numbers at the same moment. Cleared if the Goal is deleted; the copied minutes stay.Help text:* The Goal this stay is measured against. Group a report by it to count breaches by Goal. Breached Is_Breached__c Checkbox Checked once the Interval's business minutes passed Goal Minutes: set by a Live values run on an open Interval, and by the close on a closed one. Stays checked once set; Breached At records when the goal ran out. Unchecked when the Interval has no Goal or stayed within it. Breach reports, the timeline, and the Breach alert Flow read it.Help text: Checked when this stay went past its goal. Sojourn sets it while the stay is open, on each Live values run, or when it closes. Open Is_Open__c Formula (Checkbox) A formula, checked while Exited At is blank: the record is still in this value. Unchecked once the Interval closes. Reports of open stays filter on it, with Record Closed unchecked.Help text: Checked while the record is still in this value; unchecked once the stay has ended. Orphaned Is_Orphaned__c Checkbox Checked by the nightly Reconcile when the tracked record no longer exists (deleted, or merged into another record). An open Interval is closed at the deletion and also marked Closed at Deletion; a closed one is only flagged. The Interval is kept as history. Cleared if the record is restored from the Recycle Bin. Unchecked on Intervals of records that exist.Help text: Checked when the record this stay belongs to was deleted or merged away. The stay is kept for reporting; restoring the record clears it. Warning Is_Warning__c Checkbox Business minutes reached Warn Minutes, the goal's warn at percent stamped on the Interval: the Interval is close to its goal, or past it. Set as Breached is, by Live values on open Intervals and by the close on closed ones; a breached Interval is also a warning.Help text: Set when business minutes reach the goal's Warn at percent. Filter reports on it to find stays close to their goal. Lead Rating Lead_Rating__c Text (255) The Lead's Rating (its API value, as text) copied when the Interval opened, so time can be reported by rating as it was then. Filled only on Intervals of Leads; a later edit to the Lead does not change it. Blank when the Lead had no Rating.Help text: The Lead's rating when this stay began, for example Hot. Group a report by it to compare time by rating. Lead Source Lead_Source__c Text (255) The Lead's Lead Source (its API value, as text) copied when the Interval opened, so time can be reported by source as it was then. Filled only on Intervals of Leads; a later edit to the Lead does not change it. Blank when the Lead had no source.Help text: The Lead's source when this stay began, for example Web. Group a report by it to compare time by source. Lead Lead__c Lookup (Lead) Lookup to the Lead when the Tracked object is Lead, filled from Parent Id when the Interval is written, so the Leads with Intervals report type and the Intervals related list on the Lead work. Blank for other objects, or when the Tracked object's Lookup Field Override names another lookup to Lead. Cleared if the Lead is deleted; Parent Id keeps the Id.Help text: The Lead this stay belongs to. Sojourn fills it on Lead Intervals; it drives the Intervals related list on the Lead and the Leads with Intervals reports. Opportunity Amount Opportunity_Amount__c Number (18, 2) The Opportunity's Amount copied when the Interval opened, as a plain number in the Opportunity's own currency with no conversion, so a total across currencies needs care. Filled only on Intervals of Opportunities; a later edit does not change it. Blank when the Opportunity had no Amount. Not readable with the Sojourn User or Site User permission set.Help text: The Opportunity's amount when this stay began, in the Opportunity's currency. Use it to weigh time in stage by deal size. Opportunity Stage Opportunity_Stage__c Text (255) The Opportunity's Stage (its API value, as text) copied when the Interval opened, so any tracked field's time can be reported by the stage the deal was in. Filled only on Intervals of Opportunities; a later edit does not change it.Help text: The Opportunity's stage when this stay began. Group a report by it to see, for example, time with each owner per stage. Opportunity Opportunity__c Lookup (Opportunity) Lookup to the Opportunity when the Tracked object is Opportunity, filled from Parent Id when the Interval is written, so the Opportunities with Intervals report type and the Intervals related list on the Opportunity work. Blank for other objects, or when the Tracked object's Lookup Field Override names another lookup to Opportunity. Cleared if the Opportunity is deleted; Parent Id keeps the Id.Help text: The Opportunity this stay belongs to. Sojourn fills it on Opportunity Intervals; it drives the Intervals related list on the Opportunity and the Opportunities with Intervals reports. Owner Id Owner_Id__c Text (18) The 18-character Id of the user or queue that owned the record during this Interval, whichever field the Interval tracks, so time in a status can be reported by owner. Copied when the Interval opens, and corrected when an assignment rule changes the owner in the same save. Blank when the object has no owner. Sojourn reads it to find the queue's business hours (Queue Business Hours).Help text: The Id of the user or queue that owned the record during this stay. Owner Name Owner_Name__c Text (255) The display name of the user or queue in Owner Id, up to 255 characters, copied when the Interval opened so reports and the timeline show names without a join. A later rename of the user or queue does not change it. Blank when the object has no owner.Help text: The name of the user or queue that owned the record during this stay. Owner Type Owner_Type__c Picklist: User, Queue Whether Owner Id is a user or a queue: User or Queue, set with Owner Id. Blank when the object has no owner. Reports filter on it to split time with people from time waiting in queues.Help text: User or Queue: who owned the record during this stay. Filter on Queue to see waiting time. Owner User Owner_User__c Lookup (User) Lookup to the User in Owner Id when the owner was a user; blank when a queue owned the record or the object has no owner. A lookup so reports can group by the owner's role, manager, or other user fields.Help text: The user who owned the record during this stay. Blank when a queue owned it. Parent Created At Parent_Created_At__c DateTime The tracked record's Created Date, copied when the Interval opened, so reports can group stays by when their records were created, for example Cases created this month. Never changes after the copy.Help text: When the record this stay belongs to was created. Group by it to compare records created in the same period. Parent Id Parent_Id__c Text (18) The 18-character Id of the tracked record, stored as text so Intervals work for any object, standard or custom. Set when the Interval is written; never blank. Sojourn finds a record's Intervals by it (the timeline, Reconcile, the Case figures), and fills the Case, Lead, or Opportunity lookup from it.Help text: The Id of the record this stay belongs to. Parent Name Parent_Name__c Text (255) The record's name or number, up to 255 characters, copied when the Interval opened: the value of the Tracked object's Name Field, or of the object's own name field when that is blank. Lets reports and Sojourn Dashboards show and filter by a readable key, such as the Case Number. A later rename does not change it.Help text: The record's name or number when this stay began, for example the Case Number. The Tracked object's Name Field chooses which field. Parent Object Parent_Object__c Text (255) The API name of the tracked object, for example Case or Work_Order__c, set when the Interval is written. One Interval object holds the stays of every Tracked object, so reports and Interval Summaries group by it first.Help text: The object the record belongs to, for example Case. Filter on it before grouping by value. Parent Record Type Parent_Record_Type__c Text (255) The developer name of the record's record type when the Interval opened. Blank for objects without record types. Reports group by it to compare time across record types.Help text: The record type of the record when this stay began. Blank when the object has no record types. Record Closed Record_Closed__c Checkbox Checked while the record is closed by its Tracked object's Closed when setting (a closed value of the status field, or the chosen checkbox). A reopen clears it on Intervals still open; an Interval that ended while the record was closed, or at its reopen, keeps it. Reports of open stays leave checked Intervals out, Interval Summaries carry it, and Live values skips closed records.Help text: Checked on Intervals of a record that is closed. Reports of open stays leave these out, so a closed record never counts as open. Sequence Sequence__c Number (9, 0) The place of this Interval in its record's chain for one Tracked field: 1 for the first, then one more for each Interval after it; a reopened record's owner stay continues the chain. A whole number. Sojourn reads it to keep the chain in order and find the last stay, and the timeline orders by it.Help text: The order of this stay among the record's stays for this field, starting at 1. Snapshot 1 Snapshot_1__c Text (255) The value of the first field named in the Tracked object's Snapshot Fields, as text up to 255 characters, copied when the Interval opened, so time can be reported by a field Sojourn does not track, such as Region. Blank when no field is named or its value was blank; a later edit to the record does not change it. Not readable with the Sojourn User or Site User permission set.Help text: The value of the first field listed in Snapshot Fields on the Tracked object, as it was when this stay began. Snapshot 2 Snapshot_2__c Text (255) The value of the second field named in the Tracked object's Snapshot Fields, as text up to 255 characters, copied when the Interval opened, so time can be reported by a field Sojourn does not track. Blank when fewer than two fields are named or its value was blank; a later edit to the record does not change it. Not readable with the Sojourn User or Site User permission set.Help text: The value of the second field listed in Snapshot Fields on the Tracked object, as it was when this stay began. Snapshot 3 Snapshot_3__c Text (255) The value of the third field named in the Tracked object's Snapshot Fields, as text up to 255 characters, copied when the Interval opened, so time can be reported by a field Sojourn does not track. Blank when fewer than three fields are named or its value was blank; a later edit to the record does not change it. Not readable with the Sojourn User or Site User permission set.Help text: The value of the third field listed in Snapshot Fields on the Tracked object, as it was when this stay began. Snapshot 4 Snapshot_4__c Text (255) The value of the fourth field named in the Tracked object's Snapshot Fields, as text up to 255 characters, copied when the Interval opened, so time can be reported by a field Sojourn does not track. Blank when fewer than four fields are named or its value was blank; a later edit to the record does not change it. Not readable with the Sojourn User or Site User permission set.Help text: The value of the fourth field listed in Snapshot Fields on the Tracked object, as it was when this stay began. Snapshot 5 Snapshot_5__c Text (255) The value of the fifth field named in the Tracked object's Snapshot Fields, as text up to 255 characters, copied when the Interval opened, so time can be reported by a field Sojourn does not track. Blank when fewer than five fields are named or its value was blank; a later edit to the record does not change it. Not readable with the Sojourn User or Site User permission set.Help text: The value of the fifth field listed in Snapshot Fields on the Tracked object, as it was when this stay began. Source Source__c Picklist: Trigger, Flow, Backfill-History, Backfill-Seed, Manual-Repair, Reconcile, Catch-Up, Omni-Channel How this Interval was written. One of: Trigger (a save caught by a trigger, such as Sojourn's on Case, Lead, and Opportunity), Flow (a save reported by an object's capture Flow), Backfill-History (a Backfill from field history), Backfill-Seed (a Backfill from current values), Reconcile (the nightly job, for a change capture missed), Catch-Up (changes replayed after a pause), Manual-Repair (created from an error in the Health Monitor), or Omni-Channel (agent work reported by the Sojourn Omni-Channel package). Set when the Interval opens; never blank. For every source but Trigger and Flow, Changed By is the user who ran or scheduled the job.Help text: How Sojourn recorded this stay: Trigger and Flow are live saves; Backfill-History and Backfill-Seed come from a Backfill; Reconcile and Catch-Up are jobs; Manual-Repair comes from the Health Monitor; Omni-Channel is agent work. Summarised At Summarised_At__c DateTime When the Summaries job counted this closed Interval into its Interval Summary rows. Blank until then; an Interval that Reconcile closed for a deleted record waits until the Recycle Bin's 15 days have passed. Summaries counts only closed Intervals with it blank, so none is counted twice, and purge deletes only Intervals that have it.Help text: Set by the Summaries job when it counts this stay. Purge never deletes a stay that has not been summarised. To Value Id To_Value_Id__c Text (18) For an owner or lookup field, the 18-character Id of the user, queue, or record the field pointed at during this Interval; To Value holds its name. Blank for other field types. Sojourn compares values by it, so renaming a user or record does not start a new Interval, and the Case figures read it to tell users from queues.Help text: The Id of the user, queue, or record behind To Value, for owner and lookup fields. Blank for other fields. To Value Label To_Value_Label__c Text (255) For a picklist field, the label of To Value when the Interval opened, up to 255 characters, for readable report groups and the timeline. Blank for other field types. To Value keeps the API value, which does not change when a label is renamed or translated.Help text: The picklist label of the value during this stay. Blank for fields that are not picklists. To Value To_Value__c Text (255) The value the record held during this Interval, up to 255 characters: the API value for a picklist, the display name of the user, queue, or record for an owner or lookup field (its Id is in To Value Id), and the value as text for any other type. Blank when the field was blank and the Tracked field's Start At First Value is off. Goals match on it, and reports group by it after filtering on Tracked Field.Help text: The value the record had during this stay, for example Working, or the owner's name. Tracked Field Label Tracked_Field_Label__c Text (255) The Tracked field's label (its Field Label) when the Interval opened, for example Status, up to 255 characters, so report headers and the timeline read naturally. A later label change applies to new Intervals only.Help text: The name of the tracked field this stay is for, as people see it. Tracked Field Tracked_Field__c Text (255) The API name of the field this Interval tracks, for example Status, or OwnerId for the owner, up to 255 characters. One record has a chain of Intervals for each Tracked field, so always filter or group by it before grouping by value; Sojourn finds a record's chain by Parent Id and this name.Help text: API name of the tracked field, for example Status or OwnerId. Value Group Value_Group__c Text (255) The name of the value group this Interval's value belongs to, for example Backlog for New and Reopened, up to 255 characters. Blank while the Tracked field has no value groups. Interval Summaries key on it, and it is copied to the purge CSV and the Interval Archive, so reports and Sojourn Dashboards can add up time by group.Help text: The named group of values this stay counts toward in reports and summaries. Blank when the field has no value groups. Warn Minutes Warn_Minutes__c Number (16, 2) Business minutes at which the Interval becomes a warning, copied from the goal at capture time with Goal Minutes: the goal's Warn at percent of its target, a percent above 100 counting as 100. Blank when the goal has no warn percent. The warning reads this value, so a later change to the goal, or turning it off, leaves it as it was.Help text: Business minutes at which this stay is flagged as a warning: the goal's Warn at percent of Goal Minutes, copied when the stay began. Warned At Warned_At__c DateTime When the business minutes reached Warn Minutes: Entered At plus Warn Minutes, in the Interval's business hours. Kept once set.Help text: When the stay reached the goal's Warn at percent, counted in its business hours from Entered At.

docs.text:
API name: Lead

Field API name Type Description Sojourn Owner Business Minutes Owner_Business_Minutes__c Number (16, 2) Business minutes the Lead has spent with its current owner: the business minutes to date of its open Owner Interval. Written by each Live values run on the Plus plan, when Live values is on for the Lead Tracked object and the owner is tracked; an owner stay older than the Live values window is not refreshed, and a closed Lead keeps its last value. Blank until the first such run. For list views, reports, and your own automation.Help text: How long, in business minutes, the Lead has been with its current owner. Sojourn refreshes it on each Live values run, on the Plus plan with Live values on; blank until then. Sojourn State Business Minutes State_Business_Minutes__c Number (16, 2) Business minutes the Lead has spent in its current status (the Tracked object's Status Field): the business minutes to date of its open status Interval. Written by each Live values run on the Plus plan, when Live values is on for the Lead Tracked object; a stay older than the Live values window is not refreshed, and a closed Lead keeps its last value. Blank until the first such run. For list views, reports, and your own automation.Help text: How long, in business minutes, the Lead has been in its current status. Sojourn refreshes it on each Live values run, on the Plus plan with Live values on; blank until then.
