Field API name Type Description Sojourn Owner Business Minutes Owner_Business_Minutes__c Number (16, 2) Business minutes the Opportunity has spent with its current owner: the business minutes to date of its open Owner Interval. Written by each Live values run on the Plus plan, when Live values is on for the Opportunity Tracked object and the owner is tracked; an owner stay older than the Live values window is not refreshed, and a closed Opportunity keeps its last value. Blank until the first such run. For list views, reports, and your own automation.Help text: How long, in business minutes, the Opportunity has been with its current owner. Sojourn refreshes it on each Live values run, on the Plus plan with Live values on; blank until then. Sojourn State Business Minutes State_Business_Minutes__c Number (16, 2) Business minutes the Opportunity has spent in its current stage (the Tracked object's Status Field, usually Stage): the business minutes to date of its open stage Interval. Written by each Live values run on the Plus plan, when Live values is on for the Opportunity Tracked object; a stay older than the Live values window is not refreshed, and a closed Opportunity keeps its last value. Blank until the first such run. For list views, reports, and your own automation.Help text: How long, in business minutes, the Opportunity has been in its current stage. Sojourn refreshes it on each Live values run, on the Plus plan with Live values on; blank until then.

docs.title: Purge Run
docs.text:
API name: Purge_Run__c

Field API name Type Description Archived Count Archived_Count__c Number (9, 0) How many Intervals this run copied to the Interval Archive big object, a whole number. Starts at 0 and grows with each chunk while the archive is on; stays 0 when it is off. Written by each chunk with the deleted count, so a run that stops part-way still shows what it archived, and set again when the run finishes. Shown on the Retention and purge screen of Sojourn Settings.Help text: Stays copied to the Interval Archive by this run, set by Sojourn. 0 when the archive is off. Cutoff Date Cutoff_Date__c DateTime The moment that set the scope of the run's org window: midnight, in the org's time zone, Retention Days before the day the run started. Closed, summarised Intervals of every object on the org's retention that ended before it were in scope; later ones were kept. A Tracked object with its own retention days has its own cutoff, and one set to Keep everything has none; the run's Message names each window. Set by Sojourn when the run starts.Help text: Intervals on the org's retention that ended before this moment were in scope for this purge; objects with their own window are named in Message. Set by Sojourn. Deleted Count Deleted_Count__c Number (9, 0) How many Intervals this run deleted, a whole number. Starts at 0 and grows with each chunk that archived (when on), saved its CSV file, and deleted its Intervals, all or none. Written by each chunk, so a run that stops part-way still shows what it deleted, and set again when the run finishes. Compare it with Interval Count to see whether the run reached everything in scope.Help text: Stays deleted by this run, after they were archived (when on) and saved as CSV. Set by Sojourn. Interval Count Interval_Count__c Number (9, 0) How many Intervals the run set out to purge: closed, summarised, and ended before their object's cutoff, counted once when the run started across every window, the number the typed confirmation of Purge now shows. A whole number. Deleted Count says how many went; the two differ when purge was turned off or the plan changed during the run, a chunk failed, a window could not start, an object's retention changed, or Intervals changed meanwhile.Help text: Stays in scope when the run started. Compare it with Deleted Count. Message Message__c LongTextArea (32768) The run's result in words, written by Sojourn when the run finishes. A complete run says how many Intervals were deleted in all and in each window (the org's days, and each group of Tracked objects with days of their own), which objects keep everything, how many Day summary rows older than Summary Rollup Days were removed (Month rows are kept), and whether purge was turned off or the org moved to the Free plan during the run. A failed run says what stopped it: a chunk, of which nothing was deleted, or a window that could not start, whose Intervals are kept. Blank while the run is queued or running.Help text: The run's result, written by Sojourn: what it deleted, or why it stopped. Requested By Requested_By__c Lookup (User) The user who started the run: the admin who chose Purge now, or for the nightly purge the user the Summaries job runs as. A lookup to User, set by Sojourn when the run starts. Shown on the Retention and purge screen of Sojourn Settings, so you can see who deleted what and when.Help text: The admin who chose Purge now, or the user the nightly job runs as. Set by Sojourn. Retention Days Retention_Days__c Number (5, 0) The org's retention window this run used, in days: the Purge Retention Days setting when the run started, a whole number from 30 to 3650. The cutoff is midnight that many days before the run's day. It applies to every object on the org's retention; a Tracked object with its own days, or Keep everything, is named in the run's Message instead. Set by Sojourn when the run starts; a later change to the setting does not change it.Help text: The org's retention window this run used: closed Intervals older than this many days were archived (when on), saved as CSV, and deleted, except for objects with their own window. Status Status__c Picklist: Queued, Running, Complete, Failed Where the run stands. One of Queued (the default, when the run is created), Running (set by each chunk), Complete (every chunk succeeded), or Failed (a chunk could not be saved, and nothing in that chunk was deleted, or the next window's batch could not start, and its Intervals are kept; the reason is in Message). Set by Sojourn. Only one purge runs at a time.Help text: Running while the purge works through its chunks; Failed, with the reason in Message, when a chunk could not be saved or the next window could not start.

docs.title: Queue Business Hours
docs.text:
API name: Queue_Business_Hours__c

Field API name Type Description Business Hours Id Business_Hours_Id__c Text (18) The business hours applied while this queue owns a record, as an 18-character BusinessHours Id. Required. Read whenever business minutes are worked out for an Interval while the queue is the owner: it comes after the Tracked field's business hours and the record's business hours field, and before the Tracked object's business hours and the default. Set on the Business hours screen of Sojourn Settings, or by a settings file import, which matches business hours by name.Help text: Business hours used while this queue owns a record, for example overnight hours for a night queue. Set it on the Business hours screen. Queue Developer Name Queue_Developer_Name__c Text (255) The developer name of the queue, copied from the queue each time the mapping is saved. A queue's Id differs from org to org, so a settings file carries this name and an import into another org finds the queue by it. Blank only on a row created outside Sojourn Settings.Help text: Developer name of the queue, set by Sojourn. Used to find the same queue when you import settings into another org. Queue Id Queue_Id__c Text (18) The Id of the queue this mapping applies to, as an 18-character Group Id. Required, unique, and an external ID, so a queue has at most one mapping. Read with the configuration on every save: when a record's owner during an Interval is this queue, the mapping's business hours apply. Set by the Business hours screen of Sojourn Settings or by a settings file import; do not edit it by hand.Help text: Id of the queue. Set by Sojourn Settings when you choose the queue.

docs.title: Sojourn Settings
docs.text:
API name: Settings__c

Field API name Type Description Alert Closed Breaches Alert_Closed_Breaches__c Checkbox Whether breach emails also go for Intervals that close past their Goal. A checkbox, off by default. Read in the start condition of a Flow cloned from the Sojourn Breach Alert Template: off, the Flow emails only when an open Interval is flagged as breached, which a Live values run does; on, it also emails when the close flags an Interval that ran past its Goal before a Live values run reached it. Has no effect until such a Flow is active. Set under Breach alerts on the Alerts screen of Sojourn Settings.Help text: On: owners also get a breach email for a stay that closed past its Goal before the Live values job flagged it. Off: breach emails only for stays still open. Needs an active Flow cloned from the Sojourn Breach Alert Template. Archive Enabled Archive_Enabled__c Checkbox Whether a purge copies each Interval to the Interval Archive big object before deleting it. A checkbox, off by default. Each purge chunk reads it: on, the chunk writes its Intervals to the archive first and deletes nothing when the archive refuses them; off, the Intervals are saved only as CSV files on the Purge Run and then deleted. While it or purge is on, the record timeline also reads the archive for older stays. Set by Also copy to the archive on the Retention and purge screen of Sojourn Settings.Help text: On: each purged stay is also copied to the Interval Archive, so the record timeline can still show it. Your org includes 1 million archive records; more is a paid add-on from Salesforce. Set it on the Retention and purge screen. Dashboard Default Field Dashboard_Default_Field__c Text (255) The Tracked field a new Sojourn dashboard opens on, as the object API name and the field API name joined by a full stop, for example Case.Status. Blank, the default, is the first Tracked field: the first active Tracked object's status field, else its first Tracked field. A stored pair that is no longer an active Tracked object and one of its Tracked fields reads as blank. Saving checks the pair against the Tracked objects and fields the dashboard filters offer. Sojourn Dashboards reads it through getConfig each time the page loads, for every Dashboards user. A saved dashboard keeps its own filters. Set on the Dashboards screen of Sojourn Settings by a Sojourn Admin on the Plus plan, or by a settings file import; Reset to defaults clears it.Help text: The Tracked field a new dashboard opens on. Blank for the first Tracked field. A saved dashboard keeps its own. Dashboard Default Hours Dashboard_Default_Hours__c Text (20) Whether a new Sojourn dashboard opens on business or calendar hours: the text business or calendar, exactly. Blank, the default, is business; any other stored text reads as business. Sojourn Dashboards reads it through getConfig each time the page loads, for every Dashboards user. A saved dashboard keeps its own hours. Set on the Dashboards screen of Sojourn Settings by a Sojourn Admin on the Plus plan, or by a settings file import; Reset to defaults clears it.Help text: Business or calendar hours for a new dashboard. Blank for Business hours. A saved dashboard keeps its own. Dashboard Default Period Dashboard_Default_Period__c Number (3, 0) The days a new Sojourn dashboard covers when it opens: 7, 30, or 90, a whole number. Blank, the default, is 30 days; any other stored number reads as 30. Sojourn Dashboards reads it through getConfig each time the page loads, for every Dashboards user. A saved dashboard keeps its own period. Set on the Dashboards screen of Sojourn Settings by a Sojourn Admin on the Plus plan, or by a settings file import; Reset to defaults clears it.Help text: Days a new dashboard covers: 7, 30, or 90. Blank for 30. A saved dashboard keeps its own. Dashboard Longest Open Dashboard_Longest_Open__c Number (3, 0) The rows the Longest open table lists: the open Intervals furthest past their Goal, a whole number from 10 to 100. Blank, the default, is 50; a stored value outside the range reads as its nearer bound. Read on every Longest open data call in Sojourn Dashboards. Set on the Dashboards screen of Sojourn Settings by a Sojourn Admin on the Plus plan, or by a settings file import; Reset to defaults clears it.Help text: How many open Intervals the Longest open table lists, from 10 to 100. Blank for 50. Dashboard Max Charts Dashboard_Max_Charts__c Number (3, 0) The most charts one Sojourn dashboard can hold, a whole number from 4 to 20. Blank, the default, is 20; a stored value outside the range reads as its nearer bound. Checked when a dashboard is saved, and sent to the page by getConfig: a dashboard over a lower limit keeps every chart and cannot add one; none is ever removed. Set on the Dashboards screen of Sojourn Settings by a Sojourn Admin on the Plus plan, or by a settings file import; Reset to defaults clears it.Help text: The most charts on one dashboard, from 4 to 20. Blank for 20. A dashboard over a lower limit keeps its charts and cannot add one. Dashboard Max Dashboards Dashboard_Max_Dashboards__c Number (3, 0) The most Sojourn dashboards one person can have, a whole number from 1 to 20. Blank, the default, is 20; a stored value outside the range reads as its nearer bound. Checked when a dashboard is added, and sent to the page by getConfig: someone over a lower limit keeps every dashboard and cannot add one; none is ever removed. Set on the Dashboards screen of Sojourn Settings by a Sojourn Admin on the Plus plan, or by a settings file import; Reset to defaults clears it.Help text: The most dashboards each person can have, from 1 to 20. Blank for 20. Someone over a lower limit keeps their dashboards and cannot add one. Dashboard Owner List Dashboard_Owner_List__c Number (3, 0) The busiest owners of the period the Owner filter of Sojourn Dashboards lists, a whole number from 10 to 100, most Intervals first. Blank, the default, is 50; a stored value outside the range reads as its nearer bound. Read each time the Owner filter loads its list. Set on the Dashboards screen of Sojourn Settings by a Sojourn Admin on the Plus plan, or by a settings file import; Reset to defaults clears it.Help text: How many owners the dashboard Owner filter lists, busiest first, from 10 to 100. Blank for 50. Dashboard Print Colour Dashboard_Print_Colour__c Checkbox Whether the Sojourn Dashboards print preview starts in colour. A checkbox, off by default: off starts in black and white. Sojourn Dashboards reads it through getConfig each time the page loads, for every Dashboards user. Anyone printing can still change it in the preview. Set on the Dashboards screen of Sojourn Settings by a Sojourn Admin on the Plus plan, or by a settings file import; Reset to defaults clears it.Help text: On: the dashboard print preview starts in colour. Off: black and white. Anyone printing can still change it. Dashboard Print No Tables Dashboard_Print_No_Tables__c Checkbox Whether the Sojourn Dashboards print preview starts without each chart's data table. A checkbox, off by default: off adds each chart's numbers at the end of the printout. Sojourn Dashboards reads it through getConfig each time the page loads, for every Dashboards user. Anyone printing can still change it in the preview. Set on the Dashboards screen of Sojourn Settings by a Sojourn Admin on the Plus plan, or by a settings file import; Reset to defaults clears it.Help text: On: the dashboard print preview starts without the data tables. Off: each chart's numbers are added at the end. Dashboard Print Paper Dashboard_Print_Paper__c Text (20) The paper the Sojourn Dashboards print preview starts with: the text a4 or letter, exactly. Blank, the default, is a4; any other stored text reads as a4. Sojourn Dashboards reads it through getConfig each time the page loads, for every Dashboards user. Anyone printing can still change it in the preview. Set on the Dashboards screen of Sojourn Settings by a Sojourn Admin on the Plus plan, or by a settings file import; Reset to defaults clears it.Help text: A4 or Letter paper for the dashboard print preview. Blank for A4. Anyone printing can still change it. Dashboard Row Budget Dashboard_Row_Budget__c Number (6, 0) The most summary rows one Sojourn Dashboards chart adds up, a whole number from 5,000 to 40,000, counting each read the chart makes. Past it, the chart reads Month summary rows instead of Day rows; still past it, the chart asks for a shorter period or one owner. The Owner filter's list uses it the same way. Blank, the default, is 20,000; a stored value outside the range reads as its nearer bound. Read on every chart and Owner filter data call. Set on the Dashboards screen of Sojourn Settings by a Sojourn Admin on the Plus plan, or by a settings file import; Reset to defaults clears it.Help text: Summary rows one dashboard chart adds up before it reads Month rows, from 5,000 to 40,000. Blank for 20,000. Dashboard Top Owners Dashboard_Top_Owners__c Number (3, 0) The busiest owners an owner chart shows, a whole number from 5 to 20: Bars by owner and the Heatmap draw this many owners, most Intervals first, and add up the rest as Others. Blank, the default, is 12; a stored value outside the range reads as its nearer bound. Read on every owner chart's data call in Sojourn Dashboards. Set on the Dashboards screen of Sojourn Settings by a Sojourn Admin on the Plus plan, or by a settings file import; Reset to defaults clears it.Help text: How many owners Bars by owner and the Heatmap show before the rest add up as Others, from 5 to 20. Blank for 12. Dashboard Trend Values Dashboard_Trend_Values__c Number (1, 0) The busiest values a Trend chart draws, a line each, a whole number from 1 to 3. Blank, the default, is 3; a stored value outside the range reads as its nearer bound. Read on every Trend chart's data call in Sojourn Dashboards. Set on the Dashboards screen of Sojourn Settings by a Sojourn Admin on the Plus plan, or by a settings file import; Reset to defaults clears it.Help text: How many values a Trend chart draws, a line each, from 1 to 3. Blank for 3. Default Business Hours Id Default_Business_Hours_Id__c Text (18) The business hours Sojourn uses when nothing more specific applies, as an 18-character BusinessHours Id. Blank: the org's default business hours. Read whenever business minutes are worked out, after the Tracked field's business hours, the record's business hours field, the owning queue's mapping, and the Tracked object's business hours, in that order. Business hours that are deleted or inactive count calendar minutes instead. Saved from the Overview screen of Sojourn Settings, or by a settings file import, which matches business hours by name.Help text: The business hours Sojourn uses when no field, record, queue, or object setting applies. Leave blank for the org's default business hours. A change applies to stays measured from then on; closed stays keep their minutes. Guide Marked Done Guide_Marked_Done__c Text (255) The Get started steps an admin marked done by hand: the two Sojourn cannot read in the org, timeline (the timeline on record pages) and dashboards (who sees the packaged dashboards). JSON, a list of at most two entries, each key once, in the form [{"key":"timeline","userId":"005...","at":"2026-10-22T09:14:00.000Z"}]: key is timeline or dashboards, userId the Id of the user who marked the step, at the time in ISO 8601 UTC. Blank means no step is marked. Read by the Get started screen of Sojourn Settings, which shows a marked step as done with who marked it and when; the first mark of a step is kept. A value Sojourn cannot read (not JSON, another key, a key twice, an Id that is not a user, a time that does not parse) is read as no marks and cleared by the next Mark as done or import of marks, even none. Set by Mark as done; Reset to defaults clears it; carried by the settings file, whose import checks it the same way, step by step (order is no change).Help text: Who marked the Get started steps for the record page timeline and dashboard sharing as done, and when. Set by Mark as done on the Get started screen; a value Sojourn cannot read is cleared, so do not edit it by hand. Guide Opens First Guide_Opens_First__c Checkbox Whether Sojourn Settings opens on the Get started guide. A checkbox, true by default; when the org has no Settings row yet, Sojourn reads it as true. Read by Sojourn Settings each time an admin holding Sojourn Admin opens it: true while a required step of the guide is not done, the page opens on Get started; false, or once every required step is done, it opens on the Overview. A link that names its own screen always opens that screen. Sojourn sets it false itself the first time Get started finds every required step done; the admin turns it on or off with Open this guide first on the Get started screen. Reset to defaults writes true; carried by the settings file export and import.Help text: Opens Sojourn Settings on the Get started guide while required setup steps remain. Sojourn turns it off once every required step is done; turn it on again on the Get started screen to open the guide first. Health Bad Errors Health_Bad_Errors__c Number (5, 0) Open errors above which the Health Monitor says field tracking is not working (red), a whole number from 0. Blank, the default, means never: open errors alone never turn the Health Monitor red, as before this setting, and only the failures it already names do. The Health Monitor reads it each time it loads, for every Health Monitor user. Reset to defaults clears it. Set on the Health screen of Sojourn Settings by a Sojourn Admin.Help text: Open errors above which the Health Monitor shows that field tracking is not working. Blank means errors alone never do. Health Job Late Hours Health_Job_Late_Hours__c Number (3, 0) Hours past its schedule after which a scheduled Sojourn job that has not run is late, a whole number. A job is late when its last run ended more than its period ago (its minutes for Live values, 24 hours for the daily jobs) plus these hours; the Health Monitor then shows a warning, fixed on the Jobs screen. Blank, the default, applies 2 hours. The Health Monitor reads it each time it loads, for every Health Monitor user. Reset to defaults clears it. Set on the Health screen of Sojourn Settings by a Sojourn Admin.Help text: Hours a scheduled job may run late before the Health Monitor warns. Blank means 2 hours. Health Warn Errors Health_Warn_Errors__c Number (5, 0) Open errors above which the Health Monitor says field tracking needs attention (amber), a whole number from 0. Blank, the default, applies 0, so any open error needs attention, as before this setting. The Health Monitor reads it each time it loads, for every Health Monitor user. Reset to defaults clears it. Set on the Health screen of Sojourn Settings by a Sojourn Admin.Help text: Open errors above which the Health Monitor shows that field tracking needs attention. Blank means above 0. Limit Reserve CPU Ms Limit_Reserve_CPU_Ms__c Number (6, 0) CPU time, in milliseconds, that Sojourn leaves free in each save for the org's own automation. A whole number from 500 to 9000; blank means 2000. Read by the capture engine before it writes Intervals in a save: when less CPU time than this is left, it writes nothing for that save and logs a Limit error, which the nightly reconcile retries. Set on the Advanced screen of Sojourn Settings or by a settings file import; Reset to defaults clears it.Help text: Milliseconds of CPU time Sojourn leaves for your own automation in each save, 500 to 9000; blank for 2000. Raise it if your Flows or triggers run out of CPU time after Sojourn: Sojourn then steps aside sooner and the nightly reconcile records the change. Limit Reserve DML Rows Limit_Reserve_DML_Rows__c Number (6, 0) DML rows Sojourn leaves free in each save for the org's own automation. A whole number from 100 to 5000; blank means 2000. At most 5000 because a Summaries chunk of 1,000 Intervals writes up to 5,000 rows, so a larger reserve is headroom no job reads; a value stored above it in Setup is read as 5000. Read by the capture engine before it writes Intervals in a save: when fewer rows than this are left, it writes nothing for that save and logs a Limit error, which the nightly reconcile retries. Set on the Advanced screen of Sojourn Settings or by a settings file import; Reset to defaults clears it.Help text: DML rows Sojourn leaves for your own automation in each save, 100 to 5000 (the most one Summaries chunk writes); blank for 2000. Raise it if your Flows or triggers run out of rows after Sojourn: Sojourn then steps aside sooner and the nightly reconcile records the change. Limit Reserve Queries Limit_Reserve_Queries__c Number (4, 0) SOQL queries Sojourn leaves free in each save for the org's own automation. A whole number from 1 to 50; blank means 10. Read by the capture engine before it loads its configuration, before it looks for changes, and before it writes: when the queries it needs would leave fewer than this, it writes nothing for that save and logs a Limit error, which the nightly reconcile retries. Set on the Advanced screen of Sojourn Settings or by a settings file import; Reset to defaults clears it.Help text: SOQL queries Sojourn leaves for your own automation in each save, 1 to 50; blank for 10. Raise it if your Flows or triggers run out of queries after Sojourn: Sojourn then steps aside sooner and the nightly reconcile records the change. Live Values Window Days Live_Values_Window_Days__c Number (4, 0) How far back, in days, the Live values job reaches. A whole number from 1 to 365; blank means 90. Read at the start of every Live values run: only open Intervals that began within this many days get their business minutes to date, their Breach and warning flags, and the record's live minute fields refreshed. Older open Intervals keep their last values until they close, when their minutes are worked out in full. Set on the Jobs screen of Sojourn Settings or by a settings file import; Reset to defaults clears it.Help text: Open stays that began within this many days are refreshed by each Live values run, 1 to 365; blank for 90. Older open stays keep their last values until they close. A longer window refreshes more stays in each run. Omni Open Statuses Omni_Open_Statuses__c Text (255) The Omni-Channel work statuses that open an Agent work Interval: AgentWork Status values separated by commas, each once, in the order chosen, for example Assigned,Opened. Blank means Assigned,Opened. Read by the Sojourn Omni-Channel package on every AgentWork save: a status in the list opens an Interval for the agent on the work item, and Closed, Declined, DeclinedOnPushTimeout, Canceled, Unavailable, or Transferred ends it. Saving needs the Plus plan and Omni-Channel, and every value must be an AgentWork Status. Set on the Advanced screen of Sojourn Settings or by a settings file import; Reset to defaults clears it.Help text: Omni-Channel work statuses that start timing an agent's work, for example Assigned and Opened. Blank for Assigned and Opened. Needs the Plus plan and the Sojourn Omni-Channel package. Purge Batch Size Purge_Batch_Size__c Number (4, 0) How many Intervals each purge chunk handles. A whole number from 50 to 2000; blank means 2000. Read when a purge run starts, as the batch size of its job: each chunk archives (when the archive is on), saves one CSV file to the Purge Run, and deletes its Intervals, all or none. A smaller chunk uses fewer limits and leaves more files. Set on the Retention and purge screen of Sojourn Settings on the Plus plan; Reset to defaults clears it.Help text: Leave blank for 2000. Lower it only if purge chunks fail on limits; each chunk adds one CSV file to the purge run, so a smaller chunk leaves more files. Purge Enabled Purge_Enabled__c Checkbox Whether deletion is on: true when the admin chose Keep N days, false for Keep everything. A checkbox, off by default; deletion is opt-in. On the Plus plan, the nightly Summaries job reads it when it finishes and, when it is on, starts a purge that deletes closed, summarised Intervals that ended before the retention window (Purge Retention Days). Each chunk reads it again, so turning it off during a run keeps the Intervals the run has not reached. Purge now refuses to start while it is off. Set only by the retention choice on the Retention and purge screen, which asks for the word DELETE; a settings file import leaves it as it is.Help text: Set by Keep N days on the Retention and purge screen; deletion is opt-in. On: each night, after the Summaries job, Sojourn deletes closed stays older than the window. Off: nothing is deleted. Purge Retention Days Purge_Retention_Days__c Number (5, 0) How many days of closed Intervals to keep when purge is on. A whole number from 30 to 3650. Blank: no window chosen yet, so no purge can run; the screen offers 365. A purge run reads it when it starts and sets its cutoff to midnight, in the org's time zone, that many days before today; Intervals that ended before the cutoff are purged. Keep everything leaves the last window here, but Purge Enabled decides whether anything is deleted. Set on the Retention and purge screen of Sojourn Settings.Help text: Closed stays older than this many days are deleted when purge is on, 30 to 3650. Set it with Keep N days on the Retention and purge screen. Retention Chosen Retention_Chosen__c Checkbox Whether the admin has made the retention choice, Keep everything or Keep N days. A checkbox, off by default. On the Plus plan the Overview screen of Sojourn Settings asks for the choice until it is true; on the Free plan nothing is deleted and the Overview does not ask. Set to true by any save on the Retention and purge screen. Nothing is deleted because of this field alone; Purge Enabled decides that.Help text: Set when retention is saved on the Retention and purge screen. Until then the Overview asks you to choose Keep everything or Keep N days. Summary Rollup Days Summary_Rollup_Days__c Number (4, 0) How many days of Day summary rows to keep. A whole number from 35 to 3650; blank means 400. Read only at the end of a complete purge run, which deletes up to 9,000 Day rows of Interval Summary older than this many days, the rest in the next run; Month rows are always kept, so charts and reports over longer periods still work. Without purge on, no Day rows are deleted. Set on the Summaries screen of Sojourn Settings or by a settings file import; Reset to defaults clears it.Help text: Day summary rows older than this many days are removed at the end of each purge run, 35 to 3650; blank for 400. Month rows are kept. Without purge, Day rows are never removed. Tracking Enabled Tracking_Enabled__c Checkbox The org-wide switch for all Sojourn capture. A checkbox; when no Settings row exists yet, Sojourn treats it as on. Read on every save of a tracked record, by Catch up, by the nightly reconcile, and by the jobs: off, saves of tracked records write no Intervals, Catch up refuses to start, and the Health Monitor reports tracking as off. Turning it back on does not replay what changed meanwhile; the nightly reconcile records values that drifted, at the record's last change. Set on the Overview screen of Sojourn Settings, or by a settings file import.Help text: Turns all Sojourn capture on or off for the whole org. Off: no stays are recorded until you turn it back on. Change it on the Overview screen of Sojourn Settings.

docs.title: Tracked Field
docs.text:
API name: Tracked_Field__c

Field API name Type Description Business Hours Id Business_Hours_Id__c Text (18) The business hours for this one Tracked field, as an 18-character BusinessHours Id, for example 24x7 hours for a field timed around the clock. Blank: the field inherits, and the record's business hours field, the owning queue's mapping, the Tracked object's business hours, and the default in Sojourn Settings apply in that order. Read first, before any of those, whenever business minutes are worked out for this field's Intervals. Set per field on the object's Fields tab of Sojourn Settings, or by a settings file import, which matches business hours by name.Help text: Business hours used for this field only, overriding every other business hours setting. Leave blank to inherit. A change applies to stays measured from then on. Excluded Values Excluded_Values__c LongTextArea (1000) Values of this Tracked field that do not count, one value per line, as the field stores them (the API value, not the label). Blank, the default, means every value counts. When a record changes into an excluded value, Sojourn closes the open Interval at the change and opens none; when the record moves on to a counted value, the next Interval opens with the excluded value as its From value. One rule applies on every path that opens an Interval: trigger and Flow capture, History and Seed backfill, Catch up, Reconcile drift, and repairs. Closed values and blank cannot be excluded, and a Goal cannot be set on an excluded value. Set on the Values tab of the object in Sojourn Settings, which checks it on save and on import; it applies from the next change on each record and never rewrites an existing Interval. Each line break counts as two characters.Help text: Values that do not count, one per line. Time in them is not measured: the stay before closes at the change, and no Interval opens until the record moves to a counted value. Applies from each record's next change. Field API Name Field_API_Name__c Text (255) The API name of the field Sojourn records, for example Status, StageName, or OwnerId, on the parent Tracked object. Required. Read by the capture engine on every save to compare old and new values, and checked against describe each time the configuration loads: a field the object no longer has is passed over with an Error Log row. Together with the object's API name it makes Unique Code. Set when the field is chosen on the object's Fields tab of Sojourn Settings, or by a settings file import.Help text: API name of the field, for example Status or OwnerId. Set when you choose the field in Sojourn Settings. Field Label Field_Label__c Text (255) The field's label, copied from describe when the field is chosen or turned back on, for example Status. Blank: the field's current label from describe is used. Copied onto each new Interval as Tracked Field Label, and shown in Sojourn Settings, the Goals screen, and Sojourn Dashboards. Renaming the field in Setup does not change it until the field is turned off and on again; editing it here changes the label on Intervals that open afterwards.Help text: Label shown on stays and in Sojourn Settings, copied from the field's label. Edit it to show a different name on new stays. Field Type Field_Type__c Picklist: Picklist, Lookup, Owner, Text, Checkbox, Date The kind of field, set by Sojourn from describe when the field is chosen or turned back on. One of Picklist (picklists and multi-select picklists), Lookup, Owner (OwnerId), Text (text, email, phone, and URL up to 255 characters), Checkbox, or Date (date and date/time). New rows default to Picklist. Owner makes the field an owner field: its Intervals carry the owner's name and type, and Start At First Value is ignored. How each value is stored on an Interval follows describe.Help text: Set by Sojourn from the field's type. Picklist stays hold the API value; Lookup and Owner stays hold the display name and Id. Goal Split Field Goal_Split_Field__c Text (80) API name of a picklist or checkbox field on the Tracked object that splits this Tracked field's Goals, for example Priority, so one value can have a different Goal for each priority. Blank, the default, means the Goals are not split. The name is checked against the object's fields on save and on import. When an Interval opens, Sojourn reads this field on the record and picks the most specific Goal: the value with the record's split value, then the value with any split value, then Any value with the record's split value, then Any value with any split value. An open Interval keeps its Goal when the split field changes later. Set on the Goals screen of Sojourn Settings.Help text: A picklist or checkbox field, such as Priority, whose value picks a different Goal for the same value. Leave blank for one Goal per value. Active Is_Active__c Checkbox Whether this field currently produces Intervals. A checkbox, on by default. Inactive rows are skipped when the configuration loads, so their records' changes write no new Intervals; the Intervals already written stay. Rows are never deleted: removing a field in Sojourn Settings turns it off, and choosing it again turns the same row back on with its current label and type. At most ten fields of one Tracked object can be active, the Owner field included. Set on the object's Fields tab, or by Track Owner for the Owner field.Help text: Inactive fields keep their history but stop producing new stays. At most ten fields per object can be active. Start At First Value Start_At_First_Value__c Checkbox Whether timing waits for the field's first value. A checkbox, on by default. On: a field that is blank when the record is created, or at a Seed Backfill, gets no Interval until it first has a value, and that first Interval has a blank From Value. Off: the time the field spends blank is measured too, as an Interval with a blank To Value, for example time unassigned. Read by capture, Backfill, Catch up, and the nightly reconcile. The Owner field ignores it. Set per field on the object's Fields tab of Sojourn Settings, or by a settings file import.Help text: On: timing starts when the field first has a value. Off: time spent blank is measured too, for example time before a priority is set. Tracked Object Tracked_Object__c Master-detail (Tracked_Object__c) The Tracked object this field belongs to, as the master record: deleting the Tracked object deletes its Tracked fields. Required. Its Object API Name and this row's Field API Name make Unique Code, and its settings (business hours, Closed when, Goals) apply to this field's Intervals. Set when the field is chosen in Sojourn Settings.Help text: The Tracked object this field belongs to. Set by Sojourn Settings. Unique Code Unique_Code__c Text (255) The key of this row: the Tracked object's API name, a dot, and the field's API name, for example Case.Status. Unique and matched without regard to case, so an object can track a field only once. Set by Sojourn before every insert and update; do not edit it.Help text: Set automatically as the object API name, a dot, and the field API name, for example Case.Status. Value Colours Value_Colours__c LongTextArea (4000) The colour of each value of this Tracked field on the Sojourn timeline, as JSON from a value to a palette colour name, for example {"New": "Tide", "Waiting on Customer": "Slate"}. The allowed names are Tide, Harbor, Slate, and Mist; Coral and Lantern are kept for Breach and the current Interval. Blank, the default, a value not listed, or a name outside the list takes the palette in order. Only the timeline reads it: it changes no Interval, summary, or Goal. Set on the Values tab of the object in Sojourn Settings, which checks the JSON on save and on import.Help text: Chooses the timeline colour of each value from Tide, Harbor, Slate, and Mist. Values without a colour take the palette in order. Changes only how the timeline looks. Value Groups Value_Groups__c LongTextArea (4000) Named groups of this Tracked field's values, as JSON: a list of groups, each with a name of up to 80 characters and its values, for example [{"name": "Backlog", "values": ["New", "Escalated"]}]. A value belongs to at most one group; a value in no group has no group. Blank, the default, means no groups. When an Interval opens, Sojourn writes the group of its value to the Interval's Value Group field, and summaries and reports count the values of a group together. A group change applies to Intervals that open after it: existing Intervals keep the group they were stored with, and Rebuild summaries counts them as stored. Set on the Values tab of the object in Sojourn Settings, which checks the JSON on save and on import.Help text: Puts values under one name, such as Backlog for New and Escalated, so reports and summaries count them together. Each value can be in one group. Applies to Intervals that open after the change. Values Hidden Values_Hidden__c Checkbox When checked, new Intervals of this Tracked field keep only that the value changed: the From value, To value, To label, To Id, and value group stay blank, while the minutes, the owner, and the Goals of other fields are still measured. The timeline shows such a stay as (hidden). Off by default: values are stored. It cannot be turned on while the field has active Goals, and the Goals screen does not offer the field while it is on. Set on the Values tab of the object in Sojourn Settings; it applies to Intervals that open after the change and never clears values already stored.Help text: On: Sojourn keeps how long each stay lasted but not which value it was, for fields whose values should not be copied. Applies to new Intervals only.

docs.title: Tracked Object
docs.text:
API name: Tracked_Object__c

Field API name Type Description Backfill Message Backfill_Message__c LongTextArea (32768) The result of the last Backfill on this Tracked object, in words: for a finished run, the mode, when it finished, and how many Intervals it wrote for how many records, for example "Seed backfill on 3 Oct 2026, 14:20: 400 Intervals for 200 records."; for a failed run, why, and how many chunks failed with a pointer to the Error Log. Blank before the first Backfill and while a run is queued. Written by the Backfill job when it finishes, and by a Fresh start at once. Shown on the object's Backfill tab in Sojourn Settings. Kept apart from Catch Up Message, so a Catch up never hides it.Help text: The last Backfill result, written by Sojourn. A failed run says why; the records it could not import are in the Error Log. Run Backfill again from the object's Backfill tab. Backfill Mode Backfill_Mode__c Picklist: History, Seed, Fresh The mode of the last Backfill started on this Tracked object. One of History (rebuild past Intervals from the object's native field history, where the object keeps it), Seed (open one Interval per Tracked field from each record's current value, starting now), or Fresh (add nothing; capture begins with the next change). New rows start as History, though no Backfill has run until Backfill Status says so. Set by Run backfill on the object's Backfill tab of Sojourn Settings and read by the Backfill job and the Jobs screen. History and Seed need the Plus plan; Fresh works on every plan.Help text: How the last Backfill gave existing records their Intervals. History imports native field history, Seed opens an Interval from current values, and Fresh starts empty. Choose the mode when you run Backfill on the object's Backfill tab. Backfill Status Backfill_Status__c Picklist: None, Queued, Running, Complete, Failed Where the last Backfill on this Tracked object stands. One of None (no Backfill yet, the default), Queued (the job is waiting to start), Running, Complete, or Failed (the reason is in Backfill Message). Set by Run backfill and by the Backfill job as it starts and finishes; a Fresh start goes straight to Complete. A stored Queued or Running blocks a new Backfill only while a Backfill job is really running, so a run that died and left it behind does not block the next one. Shown on the Tracked objects list, the object's Backfill tab, and the Health Monitor.Help text: Updated by the Backfill job. Failed means the reason is in Backfill Message. Run Backfill from the object's Backfill tab in Sojourn Settings. Business Hours Id Business_Hours_Id__c Text (18) The business hours for this Tracked object, as an 18-character BusinessHours Id. Blank: the default business hours in Sojourn Settings, then the org's default. Read whenever business minutes are worked out for this object's Intervals, after the Tracked field's business hours, the record's business hours field, and the owning queue's mapping, so it is the fourth choice of six. Set on the object's Records tab of Sojourn Settings, or by a settings file import, which matches business hours by name.Help text: Business hours used for this object when no field, record, or queue setting applies. Leave blank for the default business hours in Sojourn Settings. A change applies to stays measured from then on. Business Hours Source Field Business_Hours_Source_Field__c Text (255) The API name of a field on the tracked record that holds a BusinessHours Id, for example BusinessHoursId on Case. Blank: no record-level business hours. Read for each Interval of this object, after the Tracked field's business hours and before the owning queue's mapping and the object's business hours, so a record can carry its own hours, such as a region's. A value that is not a BusinessHours Id is passed over. Checked against the object's fields when saved on the object's Records tab of Sojourn Settings or by a settings file import.Help text: API name of a field on the record that holds a business hours Id, for example BusinessHoursId on Case. Set it when each record says which hours apply; it wins over queue and object business hours. Capture Mode Capture_Mode__c Picklist: Trigger, Flow A note for admins on how changes to this object reach Sojourn. One of Trigger or Flow; new rows start as Flow. Sojourn's code never reads or writes it and capture does not depend on it: Case, Lead, and Opportunity are always captured by the packaged triggers, and any other object needs an active record-triggered Flow cloned from the Sojourn Capture Template. Sojourn Settings does not show or set it; set it on the record page if you want the record to say which path the object uses.Help text: For your notes only; Sojourn does not read it. Case, Lead, and Opportunity use the packaged trigger. Other objects use a Flow cloned from the Sojourn Capture Template. Catch Up Message Catch_Up_Message__c LongTextArea (2000) The result of the last Catch up on this Tracked object, in words: when it finished, how many records it replayed, and anything still waiting, for example a pause during the run or chunks that stopped (with a pointer to the Error Log). Blank before the first Catch up. Written by the Catch up job when it finishes; a complete run also clears Paused Since. Shown as Last Catch up on the object's Backfill tab in Sojourn Settings. Kept apart from Backfill Message, so a Catch up never hides the last Backfill result.Help text: The last Catch up result, written by Sojourn. If it stopped, or capture was paused during it, run Catch up again: records already replayed are skipped. Closed Checkbox Field Closed_Checkbox_Field__c Text (80) The API name of a checkbox field on the tracked object that means the record is closed while it is checked, for example IsClosed on Opportunity; any checkbox but IsDeleted. Blank: the status field's Closed Values decide instead. Read by capture, Backfill, Catch up, the nightly reconcile, Live values, and the Case figures to tell whether a record is closed: closed records' Intervals are marked Record Closed, Live values skips them, and reports of open stays leave them out. A name that is not a checkbox on the object is ignored with an Error Log row. Set under Closed when on the object's Records tab of Sojourn Settings, or by a settings file import.Help text: Set it under Closed when on the object's Records tab, for example IsClosed on Opportunity. A record counts as closed while the checkbox is checked. Leave blank to use the status field's closed values. Closed Values Closed_Values__c LongTextArea (1000) The values of the object's status field that mean the record is closed, as API values separated by commas, for example Closed,Resolved. Used only when Closed Checkbox Field is blank. Blank: for Case with Status as its status field, the case statuses marked Closed in Setup; for any other object, no record counts as closed. Read by capture, Backfill, Catch up, the nightly reconcile, Live values, and the Case figures: closed records' Intervals are marked Record Closed, Live values skips them, and reports of open stays leave them out. Set under Closed when on the object's Records tab of Sojourn Settings, or by a settings file import.Help text: Values of the status field that mean closed, for example Closed and Resolved. A record in one of them counts as closed. Leave blank on Case to use the statuses Setup marks closed. History Chunk Size History_Chunk_Size__c Number (2, 0) How many records a History Backfill on this object reads in each chunk. A whole number from 5 to 50; blank means 20. Read when a History Backfill starts, as its job's batch size; each chunk reads every field history row of its records, so fewer suit records with long field history. Seed Backfills do not use it. Set on the object's Advanced tab of Sojourn Settings or by a settings file import; changing it needs the Plus plan, since Backfill does.Help text: Records a History Backfill reads in each chunk, 5 to 50; blank for 20. Lower it when records have long field history and History Backfill stops on limits. Ignore Queue Member Moves Ignore_Queue_Member_Moves__c Checkbox When checked, a move between two users who are both direct members of the same queue that takes this object keeps the open owner Interval open with its first owner, and no new owner Interval opens; a move to anyone else opens a new one as usual. Off by default: every owner change opens a new owner Interval. Only direct user members of the queue count; nested groups and roles are not read. Leave it off when reports should show time per person. Applies from each record's next owner change; existing Intervals are never rewritten. Set on the Values tab of the object in Sojourn Settings.Help text: On: passing a record between members of the same queue keeps one owner stay, so time counts for the team, not each person. Leave off for time per person. Active Is_Active__c Checkbox Whether Sojourn tracks this object. A checkbox, on by default. Read on every save of the object's records and by the jobs: inactive, no new Intervals are written for it, Backfill and Catch up refuse to start, and the Intervals already written stay. An object beyond Case, Lead, and Opportunity is tracked only on the Plus plan, whatever this says. Set in Sojourn Settings, or by a settings file import.Help text: Sojourn records stays only for active Tracked objects. Turn it off to stop tracking the object and keep its history. Last Paused At Last_Paused_At__c DateTime When capture on this object was last paused, stamped by Sojourn each time Pause Capture is turned on. Blank until the first pause. Read when Catch up finishes: a pause after the run began means some changes may not have been replayed, so Paused Since is kept and the result says to run Catch up again. Paused Since keeps the earliest pause not yet caught up; this field keeps the latest.Help text: Set by Sojourn each time capture is paused. Paused Since keeps the earliest pause not yet caught up. Live Owner Minutes Field Live_Owner_Minutes_Field__c Text (255) The API name of a Number field on the tracked record that Live values writes with the business minutes the record has spent with its current owner, for objects other than Case, Lead, and Opportunity, which use Sojourn's own Owner Business Minutes field. Blank: no owner minutes are written to the record. Each Live values run writes it for open records within the Live values window, on the Plus plan with Live values on; closed records are not written. Checked against the object's fields when saved on the object's Live values tab of Sojourn Settings or by a settings file import.Help text: API name of a Number field on the record. Each Live values run writes the business minutes with the current owner to it, so list views and reports can show them. Plus plan. Live State Minutes Field Live_State_Minutes_Field__c Text (255) The API name of a Number field on the tracked record that Live values writes with the business minutes the record has spent in the current value of its status field, for objects other than Case, Lead, and Opportunity, which use Sojourn's own State Business Minutes field. Blank: no state minutes are written to the record. Each Live values run writes it for open records within the Live values window, on the Plus plan with Live values on; closed records are not written. Checked against the object's fields when saved on the object's Live values tab of Sojourn Settings or by a settings file import.Help text: API name of a Number field on the record. Each Live values run writes the business minutes in the current status to it, so list views and reports can show them. Plus plan. Live Values Enabled Live_Values_Enabled__c Checkbox Whether the Live values job refreshes this object's open Intervals and its record's live minute fields. A checkbox, off by default. Read at the start of every Live values run: the run covers an object that is not paused, is on the org's plan, and has this on or has active Goals. Breach and warning flags are refreshed on every plan; writing the minute fields to the record needs the Plus plan. Set on the object's Live values tab of Sojourn Settings, or by a settings file import.Help text: On: each Live values run refreshes the minutes to date of this object's open stays and writes the live minute fields on the record (Plus plan). Goals are flagged either way. Lookup Field Override Lookup_Field_Override__c Text (255) The API name of the lookup on Interval to fill with the tracked record, for when more than one lookup on Interval points at this object. Blank: Sojourn fills the lookup named after the object, or else the first lookup to it. Read whenever an Interval of this object is written; a name that is not a lookup on Interval to the object is refused on save, and if one later stops being one Sojourn fills the automatic choice instead. Lets you add your own lookups to Interval without a package change. Set on the object's Advanced tab of Sojourn Settings or by a settings file import.Help text: API name of the lookup on Interval to fill when more than one points at this object. Leave blank and Sojourn fills the lookup named after the object. Name Field Name_Field__c Text (255) The API name of the field whose value names the record on its Intervals, for example CaseNumber or Name. Blank: the object's own name field. Read when an Interval opens, which copies the value into Parent Name for reports and Sojourn Dashboards; a later change to the field does not change Intervals already written. The field must be one the admin saving it can read. Set on the object's Records tab of Sojourn Settings or by a settings file import.Help text: Field shown as the record's name on stays, for example CaseNumber or Name. Leave blank for the object's own name field. Applies to stays that begin after you change it. Object API Name Object_API_Name__c Text (255) The API name of the Salesforce object this row tracks, for example Case or Work_Order__c. Required and unique, matched without regard to case; it is the key the capture engine, the jobs, and a settings file import match on. Checked against describe when the row is saved: the object must be one Sojourn can track, and an object other than Case, Lead, and Opportunity needs the Plus plan. Set when the object is added on the Tracked objects screen of Sojourn Settings.Help text: API name of the tracked object, for example Case or Work_Order__c. Set when you add the object in Sojourn Settings. Owner Tracking Owner_Tracking__c Text (20) Which owners get an owner Interval on this Tracked object. Allowed values: blank for users and queues (the default), Users for users only, or Queues for queues only. Any other value is refused on save and on import, and Sojourn reads it as blank. With Users, no owner Interval opens while a queue owns the record, and the user's stay closes when the record moves to a queue; with Queues it is the reverse. Applies when Track Owner is on, from each record's next owner change; existing Intervals are never rewritten. Set on the Values tab of the object in Sojourn Settings.Help text: Blank tracks time with users and queues. Users tracks only users; Queues tracks only queues. Applies from each record's next owner change. Pause Capture Pause_Capture__c Checkbox Pauses live capture for this object, for a bulk import or a data fix. A checkbox, off by default. While on, saves of the object's records write no Intervals, the nightly reconcile does not repair the object's values, Live values skips it, and Catch up refuses to start. Turning it on stamps Last Paused At and, unless an earlier pause is still waiting, Paused Since. After turning it off, run Catch up: it replays the records changed since Paused Since at their own times. Set from the Tracked objects screen or the object's screen in Sojourn Settings.Help text: Turn on before a bulk import. Sojourn skips this object until you turn it off; then run Catch up to record what changed meanwhile. Paused Since Paused_Since__c DateTime The start of the pause window Catch up replays: when capture was paused, kept from the earliest pause not yet caught up. Blank when nothing is waiting. Set by Sojourn when Pause Capture is turned on and this is blank; read by Catch up, which replays the records changed since then, and cleared when a Catch up completes with no pause during the run. While it has a value, the object is active, and capture is on again, Sojourn Settings offers Catch up for the object.Help text: Set when capture is paused. Catch up replays records changed since this time, then clears it. Record Criteria Record_Criteria__c LongTextArea (4000) Conditions a record must meet for Sojourn to record its changes, as JSON: a list of conditions, each a field API name, an operator of equals or notEquals, and a value, for example [{"field": "Type", "operator": "equals", "value": "Problem"}]. Every condition must hold. Fields are picklist, checkbox, or short text fields of the object; names are checked against the object's fields, and values are always bound, never added to a query. Blank, the default, means every record is tracked. Checked on the record's values after the save, like the record type filter: a record that does not match is skipped and its open Intervals stay open; when it matches again its next change is recorded, and Reconcile drift repairs what changed meanwhile. Set on the Records tab of the object in Sojourn Settings, which checks the JSON on save and on import.Help text: Only records that meet every condition, such as Type equals Problem, are tracked. A record that stops matching keeps its Intervals; its new changes are not recorded until it matches again. Record Type Filter Record_Type_Filter__c LongTextArea (1000) The record types to track, as record type developer names separated by commas, for example Support,Billing. Blank: every record, with or without a record type. Read on every save of the object's records and by the jobs: with names listed, a record is tracked only while its record type is one of them, and a record with no record type is not tracked. Set under Record types on the object's Records tab of Sojourn Settings, or by a settings file import.Help text: Record type developer names to track, separated by commas. Leave blank to track every record. Records of other record types get no stays. Record Type Hours Record_Type_Hours__c LongTextArea (4000) Business hours for each record type of this Tracked object, as JSON from a record type developer name to a business hours Id, for example {"Support_EMEA": "the Id of the EMEA business hours"}. Blank, the default, or a record type not listed, falls through to the next step of the Business hours order. In that order the record type step comes after the record's business hours field and before the queue's business hours. The settings file writes record types by developer name and business hours by name. Applies to Intervals that open after the change; existing Intervals keep their business hours. Set on the Records tab of the object in Sojourn Settings, which checks the JSON on save and on import.Help text: Uses different Business hours for each record type, such as EMEA support hours for EMEA cases. Record types not listed use the next step in the Business hours order. Retention Days Retention_Days__c Number (4, 0) Days of closed Intervals to keep for this Tracked object when Retention Mode is Days, a whole number from 30 to 3,650. Blank by default; ignored for any other mode. A purge run deletes this object's closed Intervals that ended more than this many days ago, only through the typed confirmation of the Retention and purge screen. Plus plan. Not carried in the settings file. Set on the Advanced tab of the object in Sojourn Settings.Help text: How many days to keep this object's closed Intervals, 30 to 3,650, when Retention Mode is Days. Retention Mode Retention_Mode__c Text (20) How long this Tracked object's closed Intervals are kept when purge runs. Allowed values: blank to use the org's retention (the default), Days to keep the number of days in Retention Days, or Everything to keep every Interval of this object. Any other value is refused on save, and Sojourn reads it as blank. A purge run deletes each object's closed Intervals by its own window, only through the typed confirmation of the Retention and purge screen, and skips objects set to Everything; nothing is deleted outside that run. Plus plan. Not carried in the settings file. Set on the Advanced tab of the object in Sojourn Settings.Help text: Blank uses the org's retention. Days keeps this object's Intervals for the days you set; Everything keeps them all. Purge deletes only through its confirmed run. Snapshot Fields Snapshot_Fields__c LongTextArea (1000) Up to five field API names on the tracked object, separated by commas, for example Priority,Origin, whose values are copied onto each Interval as Snapshot 1 to Snapshot 5, in that order, when the Interval opens. Lets reports group time by a field Sojourn does not track. Blank: the snapshot fields stay blank. A name the object no longer has is passed over; a later change to the record does not change Intervals already written. Each field must be one the admin saving it can read. Set under Snapshot fields on the object's Records tab of Sojourn Settings, or by a settings file import.Help text: Up to five field API names, separated by commas, copied onto each stay as Snapshot 1 to 5 when it begins, for example Priority or Region. Applies to stays that begin after you change it. Status Field Status_Field__c Text (255) The API name of the object's main status or stage field, for example Status or StageName. Blank: Status on Case, and no status field on any other object. Closed Values are values of this field; Goals with no Tracked field apply to it; Live values writes its state minutes from its Intervals; and Sojourn Dashboards and the Goals screen name it as the status field. Set on the object's Records tab of Sojourn Settings or by a settings file import; it should also be a Tracked field of the object.Help text: API name of the main status or stage field, for example Status or StageName. Closed values and Goals without a field refer to it. Track Owner Track_Owner__c Checkbox Whether time with each owner is tracked. A checkbox, on by default. When the row is saved, Sojourn adds or turns on an Owner Tracked field (OwnerId) for the object when it is on, and turns that row off when it is off; the row is never deleted, so its Intervals stay. The Owner field counts toward the ten active Tracked fields per object. Set on the object's Fields tab of Sojourn Settings, or by a settings file import.Help text: On: Sojourn also records how long each record spends with each owner, users and queues. Off: the Owner field stops recording and keeps its history.

The Code Analyzer workflow scans the package directories sojourn/ and sojourn-omni/ on every pull request, every push to main, and every week. It runs the AppExchange and Recommended rule selectors, which include every rule in the command the AppExchange security review prescribes, and Salesforce Graph Engine, which follows data from each entry point through the Apex classes to find missing access checks. This page is generated from those scans, and the workflow fails when the page and the scans disagree.
